"""Pure LDraw text -> mv-design-0.2 assembly payload adapter (ADR 005 D32,
docs/23_EDITOR_CONTRACTS.md C2).

Input is LDraw text (`.mpd` multi-model or `.ldr` single model, per the
ldraw.org line-based format). Output is a payload dict that validates against
``contracts.models.AssemblyDesignVersion`` with
``source_format="ldraw-import-0.2"``. The adapter is pure (text in, dict out,
no I/O, no clock, no environment) and stdlib-only; the internal
``AssemblyDesignVersion`` re-validation only guarantees the contract, it adds
no dependency.

Mapping (C2):

- ``0 FILE <name>`` blocks are sub-model definitions; the first block is the
  main model. A document without any ``0 FILE`` line is one implicit main
  model (plain ``.ldr``). ``0 NOFILE`` closes the model list (it is optional
  in real files; every OMR model checked omits it).
- Every ``1 <color> <name> <12 coords>`` line is a placement. A reference
  whose name matches a document-defined sub-model becomes a ``sub_assembly``
  component instance whose body is then inlined at the same point of the
  traversal; any other reference becomes a ``part`` component instance
  (``design_ref`` = the reference name verbatim, ``color_code`` = the parsed
  integer colour code).
- ``0 STEP`` boundaries close the current build step; steps are emitted
  contiguous 1..N and never empty (a boundary with no placements emits
  nothing). ``step.source_ref`` is ``"<model name>:<physical line of the
  step's first placement>"``; inlined sub-model content is labelled with the
  defining model's name.
- ``0 ROTSTEP`` closes a step and carries a transform for the placements
  after it: ``transform_note`` on the next emitted step is the verbatim
  ROTSTEP argument text (``"90 0 0 ADD"``, ``"0 0 180 REL"``, ``"END"``,
  ...). Notes are echoed, never interpreted; the accumulated/absolute
  rotation semantics are not modelled. A pending note attaches to the next
  emitted step (empty boundaries do not consume it); consecutive notes
  replace each other; a note at end of document is dropped.
- ``0 !LICENSE <statement>`` metas are collected document-wide. Identical
  statements are collapsed; differing statements are a typed
  ``conflicting_license`` error. ``DesignLicense.statement`` keeps the
  verbatim text. ``license_ids`` normalisation:
  ``CC BY 4.0`` -> ``CC-BY-4.0``, ``CC BY 2.0`` -> ``CC-BY-2.0``, restricted
  variants (``CC BY-NC/SA/ND``) -> ``other``, and the legacy LDraw line
  ``Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt`` ->
  ``CC-BY-2.0``: ldraw.org's legal information page states the Parts Library
  (and OMR files carrying the CA line) are "licenced by the Creative Commons
  Attribution Licence 2.0 as specified by the LDraw.org Contributor
  Agreement" and that the CCAL line is a reference to
  creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/legalcode (retrieved 2026-11-02).
  Anything else -> ``other``. Real OMR files (checked 2026-11-02, including
  additions uploaded 2026-02) all carry the legacy CCAL line; the literal
  "Licensed under CC BY 4.0 / CC BY 2.0 and CC BY 4.0" lines named by the
  OMR rules (rev 22-Nov-2023) did not occur in any inspected model file.
- Inline drawing primitives (line types 2-5) are geometry, not placements:
  they are recorded in the source document and ignored by the structural
  record. No joint topology is inferred from placements (joints stay typed
  absent); mechanism analysis is out of scope for assembly designs (C0).
- Units: LDraw geometry is in LDU. ``LDU_TO_MM = 0.4`` is the documented
  engineering policy constant (1 stud = 20 LDU = 8 mm). The normalized
  contract records structure only, so the payload carries no scale; nothing
  downstream may present the constant as a measurement.

Malformed structure raises typed errors (``LDrawStructureError`` subclasses
with ``code``/``line_no``); the adapter never guesses or repairs:

- ``design_license_missing``  no ``0 !LICENSE`` meta anywhere (typed
  rejection required by C2; the payload is never emitted with an empty
  license).
- ``empty_document`` / ``empty_model_name`` / ``duplicate_sub_model``
- ``content_outside_model``   placement/step/geometry lines before the first
  ``0 FILE`` in a multi-model document.
- ``unclosed_sub_model``      ``0 NOFILE`` while no model list is open.
- ``content_after_nofile``    model content after the list was closed.
- ``malformed_part_reference`` a ``1`` line with the wrong arity or
  non-numeric fields (colour + 12 coordinates must parse).
- ``malformed_rotstep``       ROTSTEP arguments that are neither ``END``, nor
  three floats optionally followed by ``ADD``/``REL``/``ABS``/``END``.
- ``unknown_line_type``       a line whose type code is outside 0-5.
- ``cyclic_sub_model``        a sub-model reaches itself in one expansion.
- ``empty_main_model``        the main model places no components.
- ``conflicting_license``     differing ``0 !LICENSE`` statements.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import re
from typing import Sequence

from contracts.models import AssemblyDesignVersion

__all__ = [
    "LDU_TO_MM",
    "SOURCE_FORMAT",
    "DesignLicenseMissing",
    "LDrawStructureError",
    "import_ldraw_document",
    "normalize_license_ids",
]

SOURCE_FORMAT = "ldraw-import-0.2"
#: 1 LDraw unit = 0.4 mm (1 stud = 20 LDU = 8 mm). Engineering policy for
#: display/conversion, never a measurement claim (docs/23 C2).
LDU_TO_MM = 0.4

_RESTRICTED_CC = re.compile(r"CC BY-(?:NC|SA|ND)", re.IGNORECASE)
_CC_BY = re.compile(r"CC BY\s?(\d\.\d)", re.IGNORECASE)
_CCAL_V2 = re.compile(r"CCAL\s+version\s+2\.0", re.IGNORECASE)


class LDrawStructureError(ValueError):
    """Typed parse failure: the adapter never repairs or guesses.

    ``code`` is a stable machine-readable identifier; ``line_no`` is the
    1-based physical line of the source document that caused the rejection
    (``None`` for document-level failures such as a missing license).
    """

    code = "ldraw_structure_error"

    def __init__(self, message: str, *, code: str | None = None,
                 line_no: int | None = None):
        super().__init__(message)
        if code is not None:
            self.code = code
        self.line_no = line_no


class DesignLicenseMissing(LDrawStructureError):
    """Typed rejection for an LDraw source with no ``0 !LICENSE`` meta."""

    code = "design_license_missing"


def normalize_license_ids(statement: str) -> list[str]:
    """Map a verbatim license statement onto the contract's closed id set.

    See the module docstring for the CCAL -> CC-BY-2.0 evidence. Restricted
    Creative Commons variants never map onto the attribution-only ids.
    """
    ids: set[str] = set()
    if _RESTRICTED_CC.search(statement):
        ids.add("other")
    if _CCAL_V2.search(statement):
        ids.add("CC-BY-2.0")
    for match in _CC_BY.finditer(statement):
        version = match.group(1)
        if version == "4.0":
            ids.add("CC-BY-4.0")
        elif version == "2.0":
            ids.add("CC-BY-2.0")
        else:
            ids.add("other")
    if not ids:
        ids.add("other")
    return sorted(ids)


class _ModelBlock:
    """One ``0 FILE`` section (or the implicit single-model document)."""

    __slots__ = ("name", "start_line", "lines")

    def __init__(self, name: str, start_line: int | None = None):
        self.name = name
        self.start_line = start_line
        # (physical line number, verbatim line text)
        self.lines: list[tuple[int, str]] = []


def _split_blocks(text: str, implicit_name: str) -> list[_ModelBlock]:
    """Ordered ``0 FILE`` blocks; a document without FILE lines is one block."""
    lines = [(i, ln.strip()) for i, ln in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1)]
    is_mpd = any(ln.split()[:2] == ["0", "FILE"] for _, ln in lines if ln)
    blocks: list[_ModelBlock] = []
    current: _ModelBlock | None = None
    outside: _ModelBlock | None = _ModelBlock("__outside__") if is_mpd else None
    closed = False
    for line_no, line in lines:
        toks = line.split()
        if toks[:2] == ["0", "FILE"]:
            name = " ".join(toks[2:])
            if not name:
                raise LDrawStructureError(
                    "0 FILE without a model name",
                    code="empty_model_name", line_no=line_no)
            current = _ModelBlock(name, start_line=line_no)
            blocks.append(current)
            closed = False
            continue
        if toks[:2] == ["0", "NOFILE"]:
            if is_mpd and not blocks:
                raise LDrawStructureError(
                    "0 NOFILE before any 0 FILE model block",
                    code="unclosed_sub_model", line_no=line_no)
            if closed:
                raise LDrawStructureError(
                    "duplicate 0 NOFILE: the model list is already closed",
                    code="unclosed_sub_model", line_no=line_no)
            current = None
            closed = True
            continue
        if not toks:
            continue
        if is_mpd and current is None and outside is not None:
            if toks[0] == "0":
                # document-level metas/comments before the first FILE are
                # documentation; only unplaced content is a structural fault
                continue
            if closed:
                raise LDrawStructureError(
                    "model content after 0 NOFILE closed the model list",
                    code="content_after_nofile", line_no=line_no)
            outside.lines.append((line_no, line))
            continue
        if current is not None:
            current.lines.append((line_no, line))
    if outside is not None and outside.lines:
        raise LDrawStructureError(
            "content outside any 0 FILE model block in a multi-model document",
            code="content_outside_model", line_no=outside.lines[0][0])
    if not blocks:
        implicit = _ModelBlock(implicit_name)
        implicit.lines = lines
        blocks.append(implicit)
    return blocks


def _parse_placement(line_no: int, toks: Sequence[str], model: str) -> tuple[int, str]:
    """Validate one ``1`` line; return (color_code, reference name)."""
    if len(toks) < 15:
        raise LDrawStructureError(
            f"part reference in {model} needs 1 colour + 12 coordinates + name",
            code="malformed_part_reference", line_no=line_no)
    try:
        color = int(toks[1])
    except ValueError:
        raise LDrawStructureError(
            f"part reference colour in {model} is not an integer",
            code="malformed_part_reference", line_no=line_no) from None
    for coord in toks[2:14]:
        try:
            float(coord)
        except ValueError:
            raise LDrawStructureError(
                f"part reference coordinate in {model} is not numeric",
                code="malformed_part_reference", line_no=line_no) from None
    name = " ".join(toks[14:])
    if not name:
        raise LDrawStructureError(
            f"part reference in {model} has an empty target name",
            code="malformed_part_reference", line_no=line_no)
    return color, name


def _parse_rotstep(line_no: int, args: Sequence[str]) -> str | None:
    """Validate ROTSTEP arguments; return the verbatim note text (or None).

    The ldraw.org grammar is ``0 ROTSTEP [<x> <y> <z> [ADD|REL|ABS|END]]``;
    the keyword is echoed verbatim and never interpreted (the adapter records
    build structure, not accumulated rotation transforms).
    """
    if not args:
        return None
    if args == ["END"]:
        return " ".join(args)
    if len(args) in (3, 4):
        for value in args[:3]:
            try:
                float(value)
            except ValueError:
                break
        else:
            if len(args) == 3:
                return " ".join(args)
            if args[3] in ("ADD", "REL", "ABS", "END"):
                return " ".join(args)
    raise LDrawStructureError(
        "0 ROTSTEP needs no arguments, END, or three floats + ADD/REL/ABS/END",
        code="malformed_rotstep", line_no=line_no)


class _Emitter:
    """Builds components/build_steps during the depth-first expansion."""

    def __init__(self, defined: dict[str, _ModelBlock]):
        self.defined = defined
        self.components: list[dict] = []
        self.steps: list[dict] = []
        self._parts = 0
        self._subs = 0
        self._current: list[str] = []
        self._current_ref: tuple[str, int] | None = None
        self._pending_note: str | None = None

    def place(self, *, kind: str, design_ref: str, color: int | None,
              model: str, line_no: int) -> None:
        if kind == "part":
            self._parts += 1
            cid = f"part-{self._parts:04d}"
        else:
            self._subs += 1
            cid = f"sub-{self._subs:04d}"
        self.components.append({
            "id": cid, "kind": kind, "design_ref": design_ref,
            "label": design_ref, "color_code": color,
        })
        if not self._current:
            self._current_ref = (model, line_no)
        self._current.append(cid)

    def boundary(self, note: str | None) -> None:
        # the step closing here carries the note pending BEFORE this marker;
        # a ROTSTEP's own note belongs to the step it opens (next flush)
        if self._current:
            assert self._current_ref is not None  # set by the first placement
            index = len(self.steps) + 1
            ref_model, ref_line = self._current_ref
            self.steps.append({
                "index": index, "component_ids": self._current,
                "transform_note": self._pending_note,
                "source_ref": f"{ref_model}:{ref_line}",
            })
            self._current = []
            self._current_ref = None
            self._pending_note = None
        if note is not None:
            self._pending_note = note

    def finish(self) -> None:
        if self._current:
            assert self._current_ref is not None  # set by the first placement
            index = len(self.steps) + 1
            ref_model, ref_line = self._current_ref
            self.steps.append({
                "index": index, "component_ids": self._current,
                "transform_note": self._pending_note,
                "source_ref": f"{ref_model}:{ref_line}",
            })

    def expand(self, model: str, path: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
        """Depth-first placement walk of one model instance.

        ``path`` holds the bare names of the models currently being expanded
        (the ancestry chain), so a sub-model that reaches itself — directly
        or through its descendants — raises instead of recursing forever.
        """
        if model in path:
            chain = " -> ".join(path + (model,))
            raise LDrawStructureError(
                f"sub-model cycle: {chain}",
                code="cyclic_sub_model", line_no=None)
        path = path + (model,)
        block = self.defined[model]
        for line_no, line in block.lines:
            toks = line.split()
            if not toks:
                continue
            head = toks[0]
            if head == "0":
                if len(toks) >= 2 and toks[1] == "STEP":
                    self.boundary(None)
                elif len(toks) >= 2 and toks[1] == "ROTSTEP":
                    note = _parse_rotstep(line_no, toks[2:])
                    self.boundary(note)
                # every other meta (Name, Author, !LDRAW_ORG, !COLOUR, ...)
                # is documentation, not structure
                continue
            if head == "1":
                color, name = _parse_placement(line_no, toks, model)
                if name in self.defined:
                    self.place(kind="sub_assembly", design_ref=name,
                               color=color, model=model, line_no=line_no)
                    self.expand(name, path)
                else:
                    self.place(kind="part", design_ref=name, color=color,
                               model=model, line_no=line_no)
                continue
            if head in ("2", "3", "4", "5"):
                # drawing primitives: geometry, never placements
                continue
            raise LDrawStructureError(
                f"unknown line type {head!r} in {model}",
                code="unknown_line_type", line_no=line_no)


def _collect_license(blocks: Sequence[_ModelBlock]) -> str:
    statements: list[str] = []
    for block in blocks:
        for line_no, line in block.lines:
            toks = line.split()
            if toks[:2] == ["0", "!LICENSE"]:
                statement = line[len("0 !LICENSE"):].strip()
                if not statement:
                    raise LDrawStructureError(
                        "0 !LICENSE meta has no statement text",
                        code="malformed_license", line_no=line_no)
                statements.append(statement)
    unique = sorted(set(statements))
    if not statements:
        raise DesignLicenseMissing(
            "no 0 !LICENSE meta in the LDraw source; refusing to import an "
            "unlicensed model (docs/23 C2)", line_no=None)
    if len(unique) > 1:
        raise LDrawStructureError(
            f"differing 0 !LICENSE statements in one document: {unique}",
            code="conflicting_license",
            line_no=next(ln for b in blocks for ln, l in b.lines
                         if l.startswith("0 !LICENSE")))
    return statements[0]


def import_ldraw_document(source_text: str, *, source_name: str,
                          project_id: str, version_id: str,
                          parent_version_id: str | None = None,
                          verified_by: str,
                          verified_on: str | None = None,
                          source_url: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """Convert LDraw text into an AssemblyDesignVersion-valid payload dict.

    Pure: the result depends only on the arguments. Raises typed
    ``LDrawStructureError`` subclasses on malformed structure and
    ``DesignLicenseMissing`` when the source carries no license meta. The
    returned dict is re-validated against the contract before it is handed
    out, so the payload is guaranteed AssemblyDesignVersion-valid.
    """
    if not source_text.strip():
        raise LDrawStructureError("empty document", code="empty_document",
                                  line_no=None)
    blocks = _split_blocks(source_text, implicit_name=source_name)
    defined: dict[str, _ModelBlock] = {}
    for block in blocks:
        if block.name in defined:
            raise LDrawStructureError(
                f"duplicate sub-model definition {block.name!r}",
                code="duplicate_sub_model",
                line_no=block.start_line)
        defined[block.name] = block
    statement = _collect_license(blocks)
    main = blocks[0].name
    emitter = _Emitter(defined)
    emitter.expand(main, ())
    emitter.finish()
    if not emitter.components:
        raise LDrawStructureError(
            f"main model {main!r} places no components",
            code="empty_main_model", line_no=None)
    payload: dict = {
        "schema_version": "0.2",
        "project_id": project_id,
        "version_id": version_id,
        "source_format": SOURCE_FORMAT,
        "units": "mm",
        "design_kind": "assembly",
        "components": emitter.components,
        "build_steps": emitter.steps,
        "joints": [],
        "license": {
            "statement": statement,
            "license_ids": normalize_license_ids(statement),
            "source_url": source_url,
            "verified_by": verified_by,
            "verified_on": verified_on,
        },
        "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source_text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
    }
    if parent_version_id is not None:
        payload["parent_version_id"] = parent_version_id
    AssemblyDesignVersion.model_validate(payload)
    return payload

"""Deterministic provenance helpers for packages.mechanisms.

Pure computation: no I/O, no wall clock, no environment reads. Output bytes
depend only on the passed values, so identical inputs hash identically.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib
import json

# Bumped only with a behavior change in the reference kinematics/alignment.
CODE_VERSION = "packages.mechanisms-0.1.1"
ANALYZER_NAME = "packages.mechanisms.reference"


def canonical_json(obj) -> str:
    """Stable JSON text: sorted keys, no whitespace, no NaN/Inf."""
    return json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True,
                      allow_nan=False)


def config_hash(*, analyzer: str, code_version: str, config: dict,
                design_version_id: str, design_source_sha256: str) -> str:
    """Provenance key component per docs/03: analyzer, code, config, design."""
    payload = {"analyzer": analyzer, "code_version": code_version, "config": config,
               "design_version_id": design_version_id,
               "design_source_sha256": design_source_sha256}
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(payload).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
"""MechanismSimulator provider: expected kinematic tracks for a design version.

Implements the docs/03 provider interface
`MechanismSimulator.rollout(design, phase) -> ExpectedTracks`:

- `design` is a validated `contracts.models.DesignVersion`;
- `phase` is a `RolloutPlan` describing the intended crank revolution
  (sample count, direction, crank speed); time is parametric in the crank
  angle and integer milliseconds, never wall clock;
- the returned `ExpectedTracks` carries model/config provenance, capabilities
  and the checked `CycleReport`. A schema-valid graph that cannot complete a
  revolution yields a typed non-simulation-ready result with no tracks, not a
  fabricated success and not an exception.

Pure computation: no I/O, no wall clock; byte-identical inputs give
byte-identical outputs.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import math
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import Field, model_validator

from contracts.models import DesignVersion, StrictModel

from .kinematics import CycleReport, MechanismKinematics, wrap_to_2pi
from .provenance import ANALYZER_NAME, CODE_VERSION, config_hash

__all__ = ["MechanismSimulator", "RolloutPlan", "ExpectedTracks", "PointTrack",
           "PointStateSample", "ComponentMap", "Provenance", "component_point_map"]

MIN_DT_MS = 0.5  # integer-millisecond boundary: a step below this repeats ms


class RolloutPlan(StrictModel):
    """Intended crank revolution sampling plan (the `phase` argument)."""
    sample_count: int = Field(default=360, ge=8, le=3600)  # 1-degree default
    direction: Literal[-1, 1] = 1
    omega_rad_s: float = Field(default=1.0, gt=0)
    alpha_rad_s2: float = 0.0

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def resolution(self):
        step_ms = (2.0 * math.pi / self.sample_count) / self.omega_rad_s * 1000.0
        if step_ms < MIN_DT_MS:
            raise ValueError("Rollout step is below 0.5 ms; integer-millisecond "
                             "sample times would repeat")
        return self


class Provenance(StrictModel):
    analyzer: str
    code_version: str
    config_hash: str
    deterministic: bool = True


class PointStateSample(StrictModel):
    index: int = Field(ge=0)
    phase_rad: float
    time_ms: int = Field(ge=0, strict=True)
    position_mm: tuple[float, float] | None = None
    velocity_mm_s: tuple[float, float] | None = None
    acceleration_mm_s2: tuple[float, float] | None = None
    valid: bool
    flags: tuple[str, ...] = ()


class PointTrack(StrictModel):
    point_id: str
    samples: list[PointStateSample]


class ComponentMap(StrictModel):
    component_id: str
    role: str
    point_ids: list[str]


class Capabilities(StrictModel):
    simulation_ready: bool
    full_revolution: bool


class ExpectedTracks(StrictModel):
    schema_version: Literal["0.1"] = "0.1"
    provenance: Provenance
    project_id: str
    design_version_id: str
    units: Literal["mm"] = "mm"
    capabilities: Capabilities
    cycle: CycleReport
    points: list[PointTrack]
    components: list[ComponentMap]
    warnings: list[str] = []


def component_point_map(design: DesignVersion) -> list[ComponentMap]:
    """Canonical role -> canonical joint-point mapping for v0.1 mechanisms."""
    by_role = {c.role: c.id for c in design.components}
    four_bar = design.mechanism_kind == "four_bar"
    ground_points = ["ground_pivot", "far_pivot"] if four_bar else ["ground_pivot"]
    mapping = [
        ComponentMap(component_id=by_role["ground"], role="ground",
                     point_ids=ground_points),
        ComponentMap(component_id=by_role["crank"], role="crank",
                     point_ids=["ground_pivot", "crank_pin"]),
        ComponentMap(component_id=by_role["coupler"], role="coupler",
                     point_ids=["crank_pin", "output_pin"]),
    ]
    if four_bar:
        mapping.append(ComponentMap(component_id=by_role["rocker"], role="rocker",
                                    point_ids=["far_pivot", "output_pin"]))
    else:
        mapping.append(ComponentMap(component_id=by_role["slider"], role="slider",
                                    point_ids=["output_pin"]))
    return mapping


class MechanismSimulator:
    """Deterministic expected-motion provider (pure; no I/O)."""
    analyzer = ANALYZER_NAME
    code_version = CODE_VERSION

    def rollout(self, design: DesignVersion,
                phase: RolloutPlan | None = None) -> ExpectedTracks:
        plan = phase if phase is not None else RolloutPlan()
        kin = MechanismKinematics.from_design(design)
        cycle = kin.cycle(plan.sample_count)
        provenance = Provenance(
            analyzer=self.analyzer, code_version=self.code_version,
            config_hash=config_hash(
                analyzer=self.analyzer, code_version=self.code_version,
                config=plan.model_dump(mode="json"),
                design_version_id=design.version_id,
                design_source_sha256=design.source_sha256))
        base = dict(project_id=design.project_id, design_version_id=design.version_id,
                    provenance=provenance, cycle=cycle, components=component_point_map(design))
        if not cycle.revolvable:
            # Typed unavailable result: viewable design, no expected-motion evidence.
            return ExpectedTracks(
                capabilities=Capabilities(simulation_ready=False, full_revolution=False),
                points=[],
                warnings=["no_expected_motion: " + ",".join(cycle.reasons or
                                                            ("branch_flip",))],
                **base)
        initial = design.geometry.initial_crank_angle_rad
        step = 2.0 * math.pi / plan.sample_count
        step_ms = step / plan.omega_rad_s * 1000.0
        points: dict[str, list[PointStateSample]] = {
            pid: [] for pid in ("ground_pivot", "far_pivot", "crank_pin", "output_pin")
            if pid != "far_pivot" or kin.kind == "four_bar"}
        warnings: list[str] = []
        max_overshoot = 0.0
        for k in range(plan.sample_count):
            theta = initial + plan.direction * k * step
            pose = kin.pose(theta, omega_rad_s=plan.omega_rad_s,
                            alpha_rad_s2=plan.alpha_rad_s2)
            t_ms = int(round(k * step_ms))
            for pid, state in pose.points.items():
                points[pid].append(PointStateSample(
                    index=k, phase_rad=wrap_to_2pi(theta), time_ms=t_ms,
                    position_mm=state.position_mm, velocity_mm_s=state.velocity_mm_s,
                    acceleration_mm_s2=state.acceleration_mm_s2,
                    valid=pose.feasible, flags=pose.flags))
            for state in pose.points.values():
                if state.position_mm is None:
                    continue
                max_overshoot = max(
                    max_overshoot,
                    max(0.0, -state.position_mm[0], state.position_mm[0] - design.board.width_mm,
                        -state.position_mm[1], state.position_mm[1] - design.board.height_mm))
        if max_overshoot > 0.0:
            warnings.append(
                f"expected_positions_exceed_board_by_{max_overshoot:.3f}_mm; "
                "board is a drawing extent, not a hard kinematic limit")
        return ExpectedTracks(
            capabilities=Capabilities(simulation_ready=True, full_revolution=True),
            points=[PointTrack(point_id=pid, samples=samples)
                    for pid, samples in points.items()],
            warnings=warnings,
            **base)

"""CLAP candidate-similarity adapter (D15/D14) — local-model adapter.

docs/08: ``laion/clap-htsat-unfused`` evaluates predefined candidate
descriptions on overlapping 2-second windows with 0.5-second stride, padded or
cropped according to the installed model processor. Similarity margins and
mechanical/speech reliability are FEATURES, not calibrated probabilities; a
statement that "an abrasive-like sound is heard" stays a candidate unless an
annotator confirms it. Fine sound timing comes from the DSP path, not from
CLAP's coarse window.

No weights installed here, none downloaded (D29): absent weights/dependency
return TYPED unavailable results. When the approved install IS present (see
configs/local_models.json) the success path is real: ffmpeg decodes 48 kHz
mono float samples, the window schedule slices ORIGINAL media time (tail
windows zero-padded, never extending observed time), text/audio features come
from the installed processor+model, and the pure ranking/margin/reliability
math below turns embeddings into contract-valid candidate observations.

FAILURE TAXONOMY: ``preprocessing`` (decode, chat/tensor prep),
``model_execution`` (load, device transfer, forward pass, deadline),
``output_validation`` (record construction). Stages are recorded on the run
report (`last_run`); RejectedObservation.reason stays within the shared enum.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import threading
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

from contracts.models import Confidence, Span

from ..models.observations import (
    AcousticObservation,
    AudioObservationRequest,
    ObservationBatch,
    RejectedObservation,
)
from ..models.provenance import CapabilityFlags, ModelProvenance, Unavailable, config_hash

ANALYZER_NAME = "perception.clap_htsat_unfused"
ANALYZER_VERSION = "0.2.1"
MODEL_FAMILY = "laion/clap-htsat-unfused"
DEPENDENCY_LABEL = "transformers (CLAP head)"
WEIGHTS_LABEL = "CLAP htsat-unfused weights"
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S = 300.0
DECODE_TIMEOUT_S = 120.0

#: docs/08 fixed candidate set. "speech" is a sound-class candidate; overlap
#: between it and mechanical candidates REDUCES reliability, it never deletes
#: the mechanical evidence.
CANDIDATE_LABELS = (
    "abrasive rubbing",
    "clicking",
    "speech",
    "background noise",
    "no clear mechanical sound",
)
MECHANICAL_LABELS = ("abrasive rubbing", "clicking")
WINDOW_MS = 2000
STRIDE_MS = 500
CLAP_RATE = 48000  # docs/06: 48 kHz mono derivative for CLAP
_STAGES = ("preprocessing", "model_execution", "output_validation")


class MediaDecodeError(RuntimeError):
    """Audio could not be decoded; absence of a usable waveform is NOT
    evidence about the mechanism (docs/08 missingness rules)."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ClapRunReport:
    """Measured provenance of one CLAP observe() run (F05 closure evidence)."""

    input_sha256: str | None = None
    output_sha256: str | None = None
    latency_s: float | None = None
    device: str | None = None
    model_revision: str | None = None
    revision_status: str = "not_resolved"
    failure_stage: str | None = None
    stage_detail: str | None = None
    windows_total: int = 0
    windows_scored: int = 0
    padded_windows: int = 0
    processor_padding: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    config: dict = field(default_factory=dict)


def window_schedule(duration_ms: int, window_ms: int = WINDOW_MS, stride_ms: int = STRIDE_MS) -> list[dict]:
    """Overlapping windows in ORIGINAL media time.

    Padded tail windows keep their span within real media time: padding never
    creates extra observed time (docs/08). Returns dicts with span values and
    padding facts so callers can record them.
    """
    if duration_ms <= 0:
        return []
    windows = []
    start = 0
    while True:
        end_real = min(start + window_ms, duration_ms)
        windows.append({
            "start_ms": start,
            "end_ms": end_real,
            "padded": end_real < start + window_ms,
            "padded_ms": max(0, start + window_ms - end_real),
        })
        if end_real >= duration_ms:
            break
        start += stride_ms
    return windows


def cosine(a: list[float], b: list[float]) -> float:
    num = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(a, b))
    da = math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in a))
    db = math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in b))
    if da == 0.0 or db == 0.0:
        return 0.0
    return num / (da * db)


def rank_candidates(audio_emb: list[float], label_embeddings: dict[str, list[float]]) -> list[dict]:
    """Uncalibrated cosine similarities, ranked. Never normalized to [0,1] and
    never presented as probabilities (D15)."""
    scores = [
        {"label": label, "similarity": cosine(audio_emb, emb)}
        for label, emb in label_embeddings.items()
    ]
    scores.sort(key=lambda s: s["similarity"], reverse=True)
    for i, s in enumerate(scores):
        s["margin"] = s["similarity"] - scores[i + 1]["similarity"] if i + 1 < len(scores) else 0.0
        s["rank"] = i
    return scores


def reliability_features(ranked: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Mechanical/speech reliability as FEATURES (docs/08), not probabilities."""
    by_label = {r["label"]: r for r in ranked}
    mech = max((by_label[l]["similarity"] for l in MECHANICAL_LABELS if l in by_label), default=0.0)
    speech = by_label.get("speech", {}).get("similarity", 0.0)
    return {
        "mechanical_similarity": mech,
        "speech_similarity": speech,
        #: >0 means the mechanical hypothesis is the more similar one; the
        #: magnitude is an uncalibrated margin, not a confidence.
        "mechanical_vs_speech_margin": mech - speech,
        "speech_overlap_suspected": speech >= mech,
    }


def default_weights_dir(env: dict | None = None) -> Path:
    env = env if env is not None else os.environ
    root = (
        env.get("MV_MODEL_WEIGHTS_DIR")  # approved install root (configs/local_models.json)
        or env.get("MV_MODEL_CACHE")
        or os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".local", "share", "making-visible", "model_cache")
    )
    return Path(root) / "clap-htsat-unfused"


def _resolve_weights(directory: Path) -> dict:
    marker = directory / "revision.json"
    if directory.is_dir() and any(directory.iterdir()):
        revision = license_name = None
        if marker.is_file():
            try:
                data = json.loads(marker.read_text())
                revision = data.get("revision")
                license_name = data.get("license")
            except ValueError:
                pass
        return {"present": True, "revision": revision, "license": license_name}
    return {"present": False, "revision": None, "license": None}


class ModelRunError(RuntimeError):
    """Staged inference failure; message is prefixed with the stage."""

    def __init__(self, stage: str, detail: str):
        if stage not in _STAGES:
            stage = "model_execution"
        super().__init__(f"{stage}: {detail}")
        self.stage = stage
        self.detail = detail


def _stage_of(exc: BaseException) -> str:
    """Stage from the exception attribute, else its 'stage: detail' prefix."""
    stage = getattr(exc, "stage", None)
    if stage in _STAGES:
        return stage
    text = str(exc)
    for candidate in _STAGES:
        if text.startswith(f"{candidate}:"):
            return candidate
    return "model_execution"


def ffmpeg_waveform(media_path: str | Path, *, rate: int = CLAP_RATE,
                    timeout_s: float = DECODE_TIMEOUT_S) -> list[float]:
    """Decode any ingested container to mono float samples at ``rate``.

    ffmpeg performs the 48 kHz resampling directly (no extra audio deps);
    NaN/inf from decoder edge cases are neutralized to 0.0. Raises
    MediaDecodeError on any failure — never a fabricated waveform.
    """
    ffmpeg = shutil.which("ffmpeg")
    if ffmpeg is None:
        raise MediaDecodeError("preprocessing: ffmpeg not available; audio decode for CLAP requires ffmpeg")
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [ffmpeg, "-v", "error", "-nostdin", "-i", str(media_path), "-vn",
             "-ac", "1", "-ar", str(rate), "-f", "f32le", "-acodec", "pcm_f32le", "-"],
            capture_output=True, timeout=timeout_s,
        )
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        raise MediaDecodeError(f"preprocessing: audio decode exceeded {timeout_s:.0f}s") from exc
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        tail = proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace")[-300:]
        raise MediaDecodeError(f"preprocessing: ffmpeg decode failed: {tail}")
    import numpy as np

    samples = np.frombuffer(proc.stdout, dtype="<f4")
    if samples.size == 0:
        raise MediaDecodeError("preprocessing: no decodable audio samples in the stream")
    clean = np.nan_to_num(samples, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
    return clean.astype(np.float32).tolist()


def _processor_padding_record(processor) -> dict:
    """Record the installed processor's padding/cropping facts (docs/08)."""
    fe = getattr(processor, "feature_extractor", None)
    record: dict = {}
    for key in ("feature_size", "sampling_rate", "padding", "truncation", "max_length", "do_normalize"):
        val = getattr(fe, key, None)
        if isinstance(val, (str, int, float, bool)) or val is None:
            record[key] = val
        else:
            record[key] = str(val)
    return record


class ClapObserver:
    """Coarse candidate scoring; timing evidence stays with the DSP path."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        weights_dir: Path | None = None,
        *,
        device: str = "auto",
        scoring_timeout_s: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S,
        audio_loader=None,
        runtime=None,
    ):
        self._weights_dir = weights_dir
        self._device = device
        self._scoring_timeout_s = scoring_timeout_s
        #: Callable media_path -> list[float] at CLAP_RATE (tests inject a
        #: synthetic loader); production uses the ffmpeg decoder.
        self._audio_loader = audio_loader or ffmpeg_waveform
        #: Injected (model, processor) tuple — plumbing tests only.
        self._runtime = runtime
        self._loaded: tuple | None = None
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._revision: str | None = None
        self._license: str | None = None
        self._resolved_device: str | None = None
        self.last_run: ClapRunReport | None = None

    # -- lifecycle -----------------------------------------------------------

    def _load_runtime(self, weights_dir: Path) -> tuple:
        if self._runtime is not None:
            return self._runtime
        if self._loaded is not None:
            return self._loaded
        with self._lock:
            if self._loaded is not None:
                return self._loaded
            try:
                import torch  # noqa: F401
                from transformers import ClapModel, ClapProcessor
            except ImportError as exc:
                raise ModelRunError("model_execution", f"dependency missing: {DEPENDENCY_LABEL} ({exc})") from exc
            try:
                processor = ClapProcessor.from_pretrained(weights_dir, local_files_only=True)
            except Exception as exc:
                raise ModelRunError("preprocessing", f"CLAP processor load failed: {exc}") from exc
            try:
                model = ClapModel.from_pretrained(weights_dir, local_files_only=True)
            except Exception as exc:
                raise ModelRunError("model_execution", f"CLAP weight load failed: {exc}") from exc
            if self._device in (None, "auto"):
                mps = getattr(torch.backends, "mps", None)
                device = "mps" if mps is not None and torch.backends.mps.is_available() else "cpu"
            else:
                device = self._device
            try:
                model = model.to(device)
            except Exception as exc:
                if device != "mps":
                    raise ModelRunError("model_execution", f"CLAP transfer failed: {exc}") from exc
                device = "cpu"
                model = ClapModel.from_pretrained(weights_dir, local_files_only=True)
                self._resolved_device = device
            model.eval()
            self._loaded = (model, processor)
            self._resolved_device = device
        return self._loaded

    def config(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "family": MODEL_FAMILY,
            "window_ms": WINDOW_MS,
            "stride_ms": STRIDE_MS,
            "rate": CLAP_RATE,
            "candidates": list(CANDIDATE_LABELS),
            "device": self._resolved_device or self._device,
            "scoring_timeout_s": self._scoring_timeout_s,
        }

    def provenance(self, weights_present: bool, revision: str | None, license_name: str | None) -> ModelProvenance:
        return ModelProvenance(
            analyzer_name=ANALYZER_NAME,
            analyzer_version=ANALYZER_VERSION,
            mode="local_model",
            implementation="transformers_clap_similarity",
            model_family=MODEL_FAMILY,
            model_revision=revision,
            revision_status="resolved" if revision else "not_resolved",
            license=license_name,
            weights_present=weights_present,
            config_hash=config_hash(self.config()),
        )

    # -- observation ---------------------------------------------------------

    def observe(self, request: AudioObservationRequest) -> ObservationBatch:
        self.last_run = None
        if request.audio_status != "present":
            return self._unavailable(
                request, "modality_missing",
                "No audio stream ingested; absence of audio is not absence of mechanism",
            )
        weights_dir = self._weights_dir or default_weights_dir()
        weights = _resolve_weights(weights_dir)
        if not weights["present"]:
            return self._unavailable(request, "weights_absent", f"{WEIGHTS_LABEL} not installed")
        if self._runtime is None:
            try:
                from transformers import ClapModel, ClapProcessor  # noqa: F401  (lazy gate)
            except ImportError:
                return self._unavailable(
                    request, "dependency_absent", f"Python dependency missing: {DEPENDENCY_LABEL}",
                    weights=weights,
                )
        windows = window_schedule(request.duration_ms)
        report = ClapRunReport(
            input_sha256=_file_sha256(request.media_path),
            windows_total=len(windows),
            padded_windows=sum(1 for w in windows if w["padded"]),
            config=self.config(),
            model_revision=weights["revision"],
            revision_status="resolved" if weights["revision"] else "not_resolved",
        )
        # Decode BEFORE model load: an undecodable stream is media state, not
        # a model failure, and must not burn the model load (docs/08).
        try:
            waveform = self._audio_loader(request.media_path)
        except MediaDecodeError as exc:
            detail = str(exc)
            stage = "preprocessing"
            if not detail.startswith("preprocessing:"):
                detail = f"preprocessing: {detail}"
            report = _merge_report(report, ClapRunReport(
                latency_s=0.0, failure_stage=stage, stage_detail=detail[:300],
            ))
            self.last_run = report
            return self._unavailable(request, "media_error", detail[:300], weights=weights)
        except Exception as exc:  # loader contract violation -> typed, never raised
            report = _merge_report(report, ClapRunReport(

    def _score_windows(self, model, processor, waveform: list[float], windows: list[dict]) -> list[list[dict]]:
        """Real similarity scoring over the scheduled windows.

        Text features are computed once for the fixed candidate set; each
        window's audio features come from the installed processor (which may
        pad/crop — recorded, never treated as extra observed time). The pure
        ranking/margin math does the rest. Raises TimeoutError at the
        deadline with windows scored so far discarded (the caller reports a
        typed partial; partial-window rankings are NOT returned because a
        truncated schedule would look like evidence about the whole clip).
        """
        import torch

        started = time.monotonic()
        device = getattr(model, "device", None) or self._resolved_device
        if device is None:
            device = "cpu" if self._device in (None, "auto") else self._device
        try:
            text_inputs = processor(text=list(CANDIDATE_LABELS), return_tensors="pt", padding=True)
            text_inputs = _inputs_on_device(text_inputs, device)
            with torch.inference_mode():
                text_features = model.get_text_features(**text_inputs)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise ModelRunError("preprocessing", f"text feature extraction failed: {exc}") from exc
        label_embeddings = _to_lists(text_features)
        window_samples = WINDOW_MS * CLAP_RATE // 1000
        ranked_per_window: list[list[dict]] = []
        for w in windows:
            if time.monotonic() - started > self._scoring_timeout_s:
                raise TimeoutError("CLAP window scoring deadline exceeded")
            segment = _slice_window(waveform, w, window_samples)
            try:
                audio_inputs = processor(
                    audio=[segment], sampling_rate=CLAP_RATE, return_tensors="pt"
                )
                audio_inputs = _inputs_on_device(audio_inputs, device)
                with torch.inference_mode():
                    audio_features = model.get_audio_features(**audio_inputs)
            except Exception as exc:
                raise ModelRunError("model_execution", f"audio feature extraction failed: {exc}") from exc
            audio_emb = _to_list(audio_features)
            ranked_per_window.append(rank_candidates(audio_emb, label_embeddings))
        return ranked_per_window

    def _partial(
        self,
        request: AudioObservationRequest,
        rejections: list[RejectedObservation],
        observations: list[AcousticObservation] | None = None,
        weights: dict | None = None,
    ) -> ObservationBatch:
        weights = weights or {}
        prov = self.provenance(True, weights.get("revision"), weights.get("license"))
        padding = self.last_run.processor_padding if self.last_run else {}
        if padding:
            prov = prov.model_copy(update={"note": (
                f"processor padding/cropping recorded: {json.dumps(padding, sort_keys=True)}; "
                "processor padding never extends observed media time"
            )})
        status = "ok" if (observations and not rejections) else "partial"
        return ObservationBatch(
            asset_id=request.asset_id,
            modality="acoustic",
            status=status,
            observations=observations or [],
            rejected=rejections,
            provenance=prov,
            capabilities=CapabilityFlags(audio_present=True, transcript_available=None),
        )

    def _unavailable(self, request: AudioObservationRequest, reason: str, detail: str,
                     weights: dict | None = None) -> ObservationBatch:
        weights = weights or {}
        present = bool(weights.get("present"))
        return ObservationBatch(
            asset_id=request.asset_id,
            modality="acoustic",
            status="unavailable",
            unavailable=Unavailable(reason=reason, detail=detail, dependency=DEPENDENCY_LABEL),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            provenance=self.provenance(
                present, weights.get("revision") if present else None,
                weights.get("license") if present else None,
            ),
            capabilities=CapabilityFlags(
                audio_present=request.audio_status == "present",
                transcript_available=None,
            ),
        )


def _slice_window(waveform: list[float], w: dict, window_samples: int) -> list[float]:
    """Samples for one window in original media time, zero-padded tail."""
    rate_ms = CLAP_RATE / 1000.0
    start = int(w["start_ms"] * rate_ms)
    end = int(w["end_ms"] * rate_ms)
    segment = waveform[start:end]
    if len(segment) < window_samples:
        segment = segment + [0.0] * (window_samples - len(segment))
    return segment


def _inputs_on_device(inputs, device) -> dict:
    """Processor output follows the loaded model; preserve integer/bool dtypes.

    CLAP on MPS cannot consume CPU processor tensors. This transfer is at both
    text and audio boundaries, before the real forward call.
    """
    return {key: value.to(device) if hasattr(value, "to") else value for key, value in inputs.items()}


def _feature_matrix(features) -> list[list[float]]:
    """Transformers 4 Tensor or 5 projected pooler output -> validated matrix.

    In the installed Transformers 5 CLAP, get_*_features returns a
    BaseModelOutputWithPooling whose pooler_output IS the projected embedding.
    Hidden states are not interchangeable with that representation.
    """
    tensor = features if hasattr(features, "detach") else getattr(features, "pooler_output", None)
    if tensor is None:
        tensor = getattr(features, "text_embeds", None)
    if tensor is None:
        tensor = getattr(features, "audio_embeds", None)
    if tensor is None or not hasattr(tensor, "detach"):
        raise ModelRunError("output_validation", "CLAP returned no projected embedding tensor")
    matrix = tensor.detach().to("cpu").tolist()
    if (not isinstance(matrix, list) or not matrix or not isinstance(matrix[0], list)
            or not matrix[0] or any(len(row) != len(matrix[0]) for row in matrix)
            or any(not math.isfinite(value) for row in matrix for value in row)):
        raise ModelRunError("output_validation", "CLAP returned an invalid embedding matrix")
    return matrix


def _to_lists(features) -> dict[str, list[float]]:
    matrix = _feature_matrix(features)
    if len(matrix) != len(CANDIDATE_LABELS):
        raise ModelRunError("output_validation", "Text embeddings differ from the fixed candidate budget")
    return dict(zip(CANDIDATE_LABELS, matrix))


def _to_list(features) -> list[float]:
    matrix = _feature_matrix(features)
    if len(matrix) != 1:
        raise ModelRunError("output_validation", "A CLAP audio window must return one embedding")
    return matrix[0]


def _file_sha256(path: str | Path) -> str | None:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    try:
        with open(path, "rb") as fh:
            for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
                h.update(chunk)
    except OSError:
        return None
    return h.hexdigest()


def _merge_report(base: ClapRunReport, update: ClapRunReport) -> ClapRunReport:
    """Merge explicit update fields; zero/empty field defaults never overwrite."""
    defaults = ClapRunReport()
    data = {f: getattr(base, f) for f in base.__dataclass_fields__}
    for f in update.__dataclass_fields__:
        val = getattr(update, f)
        if val != getattr(defaults, f) and val != getattr(base, f):
            data[f] = val
    return ClapRunReport(**data)

"""Pure-Python DSP for temporal acoustic change detection (docs/08).

Features on waveform windows: RMS, spectral flux, spectral centroid,
spectral flatness, zero-crossing rate, band energy ratios. Candidate acoustic
changes are localized with median/MAD thresholds using only within-clip
baselines; the threshold values are returned so they can be saved.

No numpy dependency: a small iterative radix-2 FFT (window 20 ms zero-padded
to 512 points at 16 kHz). This is a deliberate degraded-but-dependency-free
implementation; if a numpy lockfile is approved the module can dispatch to it
without changing the output contract.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import Field, model_validator

from contracts.models import StrictModel

EPS = 1e-12

#: Resolution floor for flux DECISIONS, derived from the decode contract
#: (``decode_pcm`` returns pcm_s16le, so one sample LSB is 1/32768). libm and
#: resampler arithmetic diverge by ULPs across platforms (MV-CONF-001 class,
#: CI run 36804714727), and each divergence can flip an s16 rounding boundary,
#: producing per-window spectral flux of order a few LSB on otherwise-steady
#: content (measured glibc max 7.4e-5 = 2.4 LSB vs macOS 2.6e-6 head-only).
#: 8 LSB sits safely above that noise while staying ~700x below the smallest
#: genuine transient the fixtures exercise: below this resolution a flux
#: difference is not resolvable by this pipeline and must read as "no
#: resolvable change" on every platform, never as an acoustic event.
FLUX_RESOLUTION = 8.0 / 32768.0


class DspConfig(StrictModel):
    sample_rate: int = Field(default=16000, ge=8000, le=96000, strict=True)
    window_ms: int = Field(default=20, ge=5, le=100, strict=True)   # docs/06: 20 ms
    hop_ms: int = Field(default=10, ge=1, le=50, strict=True)       # docs/06: 10 ms hop
    fft_size: int = Field(default=512, ge=64, le=4096, strict=True)
    #: Hann windowing on the spectral path reduces leakage; RMS and ZCR stay
    #: on raw samples. "none" keeps the raw rectangular window.
    window_function: Literal["hann", "none"] = "hann"
    flux_threshold_k: float = Field(default=3.5, gt=0)
    band_edges_hz: tuple[float, ...] = (0.0, 300.0, 3000.0, 8000.0)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def checks(self):
        if self.hop_ms > self.window_ms:
            raise ValueError("Hop cannot exceed window")
        if self.fft_size & (self.fft_size - 1):
            raise ValueError("fft_size must be a power of two")
        if self.fft_size < self.sample_rate * self.window_ms / 1000:
            raise ValueError("fft_size must cover the analysis window")
        edges = list(self.band_edges_hz)
        if edges != sorted(edges) or len(edges) < 3 or edges[0] < 0:
            raise ValueError("band_edges_hz must be increasing, start at 0")
        if edges[-1] > self.sample_rate / 2:
            raise ValueError("band_edges_hz exceeds Nyquist")
        return self


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WindowFeatures:
    start_ms: int
    end_ms: int
    rms: float
    zcr: float
    centroid_hz: float
    flatness: float
    flux: float
    band_ratios: tuple[float, ...]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ChangeCandidate:
    start_ms: int
    end_ms: int
    flux: float
    threshold: float


def pcm_s16le_to_float(data: bytes) -> list[float]:
    """Little-endian s16 -> floats in [-1, 1)."""
    n = len(data) // 2
    out = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        v = int.from_bytes(data[2 * i:2 * i + 2], "little", signed=True)
        out[i] = v / 32768.0
    return out


def frame_bounds(n_samples: int, sample_rate: int, window_ms: int, hop_ms: int) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    """Half-open [start, end) sample windows; a partial tail window is dropped."""
    w = sample_rate * window_ms // 1000
    h = sample_rate * hop_ms // 1000
    if w <= 0 or h <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Window and hop must produce nonzero sample counts")
    return [(s, s + w) for s in range(0, n_samples - w + 1, h)]


def fft_magnitudes(samples: list[float], fft_size: int) -> list[float]:
    """Magnitudes of the first fft_size//2+1 bins of a zero-padded real FFT."""
    re = list(samples[:fft_size]) + [0.0] * max(0, fft_size - len(samples))
    im = [0.0] * fft_size
    _fft_inplace(re, im)
    half = fft_size // 2
    return [math.hypot(re[k], im[k]) for k in range(half + 1)]


def _fft_inplace(re: list[float], im: list[float]) -> None:
    """Iterative radix-2 Cooley-Tukey; len must be a power of two."""
    n = len(re)
    if n & (n - 1):
        raise ValueError("FFT size must be a power of two")
    j = 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        bit = n >> 1
        while j & bit:
            j ^= bit
            bit >>= 1
        j |= bit
        if i < j:
            re[i], re[j] = re[j], re[i]
            im[i], im[j] = im[j], im[i]
    length = 2
    while length <= n:
        ang = -2.0 * math.pi / length
        wr = math.cos(ang)
        wi = math.sin(ang)
        for start in range(0, n, length):
            cr = 1.0
            ci = 0.0
            half = length // 2
            for k in range(half):
                i1, i2 = start + k, start + k + half
                tr = re[i2] * cr - im[i2] * ci
                ti = re[i2] * ci + im[i2] * cr
                re[i2] = re[i1] - tr
                im[i2] = im[i1] - ti
                re[i1] += tr
                im[i1] += ti
                cr, ci = cr * wr - ci * wi, cr * wi + ci * wr
        length <<= 1


def _hann(n: int) -> list[float]:
    return [0.5 * (1.0 - math.cos(2.0 * math.pi * i / (n - 1))) for i in range(n)]


def window_features(
    samples: list[float],
    prev_mag: list[float] | None,
    cfg: DspConfig,
    start_sample: int,
) -> tuple[WindowFeatures, list[float]]:
    """Compute one window's features and return (features, magnitudes).

    RMS and ZCR use the raw samples; the spectrum uses the configured window
    function so centroid/flatness/flux are not dominated by leakage.
    """
    n = len(samples)
    mean = sum(samples) / n
    rms = math.sqrt(sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in samples) / n)
    zcr = sum(
        1 for i in range(1, n) if (samples[i - 1] < 0) != (samples[i] < 0)
    ) / max(1, n - 1)
    if cfg.window_function == "hann":
        w = _hann(n)
        spectral = [s * wi for s, wi in zip(samples, w)]
    else:
        spectral = samples
    mag = fft_magnitudes(spectral, cfg.fft_size)
    total = sum(mag) + EPS
    bin_hz = cfg.sample_rate / cfg.fft_size
    centroid = sum(k * bin_hz * m for k, m in enumerate(mag)) / total
    n_bins = len(mag)
    log_sum = sum(math.log(m + EPS) for m in mag)
    geo = math.exp(log_sum / n_bins)
    ari = total / n_bins
    flatness = geo / ari
    if prev_mag is None:
        flux = 0.0
    else:
        flux = sum(max(0.0, m - p) for m, p in zip(mag, prev_mag)) / (sum(prev_mag) + EPS)
    edges = list(cfg.band_edges_hz) + [float("inf")]
    band_e = [0.0] * (len(edges) - 1)
    for k, m in enumerate(mag):
        f = k * bin_hz
        for b in range(len(band_e) - 1):
            if edges[b] <= f < edges[b + 1]:
                band_e[b] += m * m
                break
    total_e = sum(band_e) + EPS
    ratios = tuple(e / total_e for e in band_e)
    start_ms = round(start_sample / cfg.sample_rate * 1000)
    end_ms = round((start_sample + n) / cfg.sample_rate * 1000)
    feats = WindowFeatures(
        start_ms=start_ms,
        end_ms=end_ms,
        rms=rms,
        zcr=zcr,
        centroid_hz=centroid,
        flatness=flatness,
        flux=flux,
        band_ratios=ratios,
    )
    return feats, mag


def compute_features(pcm: list[float], cfg: DspConfig) -> list[WindowFeatures]:
    bounds = frame_bounds(len(pcm), cfg.sample_rate, cfg.window_ms, cfg.hop_ms)
    out: list[WindowFeatures] = []
    prev: list[float] | None = None
    for (a, b) in bounds:
        feats, prev = window_features(pcm[a:b], prev, cfg, a)
        out.append(feats)
    return out


def _median(values: list[float]) -> float:
    s = sorted(values)
    m = len(s) // 2
    return s[m] if len(s) % 2 else (s[m - 1] + s[m]) / 2


def _mad(values: list[float], med: float) -> float:
    return _median([abs(v - med) for v in values])


def localize_changes(features: list[WindowFeatures], cfg: DspConfig) -> tuple[list[ChangeCandidate], float]:
    """Median + k*MAD threshold over the within-clip flux series (docs/08).

    Returns (candidates, saved_threshold). A constant signal has MAD 0; the
    floor keeps the threshold strictly above the plateau so no candidate is
    manufactured from uniformity. The floor is never below FLUX_RESOLUTION:
    the median/MAD rule computed from near-uniform noise collapses to ~0 and
    would let platform float noise cross it, so a collapsed threshold is
    clamped to the pipeline's declared s16 resolution instead.
    """
    if len(features) < 3:
        return [], 0.0
    flux = [f.flux for f in features]
    med = _median(flux)
    mad = _mad(flux, med)
    threshold = max(
        med + cfg.flux_threshold_k * max(mad, abs(med) * 1e-9, EPS),
        FLUX_RESOLUTION,
    )
    candidates: list[ChangeCandidate] = []
    for i in range(1, len(features) - 1):
        f = features[i]
        if f.flux > threshold and f.flux >= features[i - 1].flux and f.flux >= features[i + 1].flux:
            candidates.append(
                ChangeCandidate(start_ms=f.start_ms, end_ms=f.end_ms, flux=f.flux, threshold=threshold)
            )
    return candidates, threshold

                request.media_path, inspection, rate=cfg.sample_rate, channels=1,

            self.last_run = DspRunReport(failure_code=exc.failure.code, config=cfg.model_dump())

            source_sha256=file_sha256(request.media_path),

            decoded_duration_ms=mono.duration_ms,
            source_channels=audio.channels,

            partial_tail_samples=(len(samples) - (len(features) - 1) * cfg.sample_rate * cfg.hop_ms // 1000

            config=cfg.model_dump(),

            return self._unavailable(
                request, "empty_input", "No complete DSP window lies inside the original source bounds", True,
            )
        observed_span = Span(start_ms=feature_records[0]["start_ms"], end_ms=feature_records[-1]["end_ms"])
        summary = (
            "Decoded waveform DSP measurement: "
            f"{len(valid_features)} windows, {cfg.window_ms} ms window/{cfg.hop_ms} ms hop, "
            f"median RMS {dsp._median([f.rms for f in valid_features]):.6f}, "
            f"peak RMS {max(f.rms for f in valid_features):.6f}; "
            f"within-clip spectral-flux threshold {threshold:.6f}. "
            + ("The decoded PCM samples are digital silence. " if signal_state == "digital_silence" else "")
            + "Speech and sound classes are unassessed; this measurement does not establish mechanical contact or cause."
        )
        observations = [AcousticObservation(
            kind="dsp_summary", span=observed_span, statement=summary,
            feature_value=dsp._median([f.rms for f in valid_features]), threshold=threshold,
            confidence=Confidence(kind="not_applicable"),
        )]
        for candidate in candidates:
            span = source_span(
                candidate.start_ms, candidate.end_ms,
                source_start_ms=audio.start_time_ms, source_duration_ms=request.duration_ms,
            )
            if span is not None:
                observations.append(AcousticObservation(
                    kind="dsp_change_candidate", span=span,
                    statement=(f"Waveform acoustic change candidate at {span.start_ms}-{span.end_ms} ms: "
                               f"spectral flux {candidate.flux:.6f} exceeds saved within-clip threshold "
                               f"{candidate.threshold:.6f}. The sound source and class are unassigned; "
                               "the change does not establish contact or cause."),
                    feature_value=candidate.flux, threshold=candidate.threshold,
                    confidence=Confidence(kind="uncalibrated_score", value=candidate.flux),
                ))
        if energy_loss:
            observations.append(AcousticObservation(
                kind="reliability_note", span=observed_span,
                statement="Channel-to-mono energy loss is flagged; mono DSP features may hide sounds from the original channels.",
                confidence=Confidence(kind="not_applicable"),
            ))

        # capabilities. Neither becomes evidence that the mechanism is quiet.
        partial = energy_loss or len(valid_features) < len(features) or mono.truncated or len(mono.data) >= max_bytes
        return ObservationBatch(
            asset_id=request.asset_id, modality="acoustic", status="partial" if partial else "ok",
            observations=observations, provenance=self.provenance,
            capabilities=CapabilityFlags(audio_present=True),
        )

    def _unavailable(self, request, reason, detail, audio_present):
        return ObservationBatch(
            asset_id=request.asset_id, modality="acoustic", status="unavailable",
            unavailable=Unavailable(reason=reason, detail=detail), provenance=self.provenance,
            capabilities=CapabilityFlags(audio_present=audio_present),
        )


def file_sha256(path: str | Path) -> str | None:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    try:
        with open(path, "rb") as stream:
            for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
                digest.update(chunk)
    except OSError:
        return None
    return digest.hexdigest()

"""faster-whisper small local ASR adapter (D15) — typed-unavailable adapter.

docs/06: ASR output is an attributed fallible transcript with intervals and
review status; the transcript is quoted as a report, not ground truth.
docs/08: language mode is explicit, never silently English-only; an empty
result or VAD decision is not proof of silence.

No weights are installed here and none are downloaded (D29): absent weights or
dependency return TYPED unavailable results. The segment-parsing path is a
pure function, unit-tested with a synthetic fake ``faster_whisper`` module and
fixture weights directory (clearly synthetic; no real model executed).

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from dataclasses import dataclass
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

from contracts.models import Confidence, Span

from ..models.observations import (
    AudioObservationRequest,
    ObservationBatch,
    RejectedObservation,
    TranscriptRecord,
)
from ..media.limits import sanitize
from .pipeline import file_sha256

from ..models.provenance import CapabilityFlags, ModelProvenance, Unavailable, config_hash

ANALYZER_NAME = "perception.whisper_small"
ANALYZER_VERSION = "0.2.0"
MODEL_FAMILY = "faster-whisper:small"
DEPENDENCY_LABEL = "faster-whisper"
WEIGHTS_LABEL = "faster-whisper small (multilingual) weights"


def default_weights_dir(env: dict | None = None) -> Path:
    env = env if env is not None else os.environ
    root = env.get("MV_MODEL_WEIGHTS_DIR") or env.get("MV_MODEL_CACHE") or os.path.join(
        os.path.expanduser("~"), ".local", "share", "making-visible", "model_cache"
    )
    return Path(root) / "faster-whisper-small"


def _resolve_weights(directory: Path) -> dict:
    marker = directory / "revision.json"
    if directory.is_dir() and any(directory.iterdir()):
        revision = license_name = None
        if marker.is_file():
            try:
                data = json.loads(marker.read_text())
                revision = data.get("revision")
                license_name = data.get("license")
            except ValueError:
                pass
        return {"present": True, "revision": revision, "license": license_name}
    return {"present": False, "revision": None, "license": None}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WhisperRunReport:
    input_sha256: str | None = None
    output_sha256: str | None = None
    latency_s: float | None = None
    device: str | None = None
    compute_type: str | None = None
    model_revision: str | None = None
    model_loaded: bool = False
    transcription_invoked: bool = False
    segments_accepted: int = 0
    failure_stage: str | None = None
    stage_detail: str | None = None
    detected_language: str | None = None


class WhisperObserver:
    def __init__(
        self,
        weights_dir: Path | None = None,
        *,
        segment_timeout_s: float = 300.0,
        device: str = "cpu",
        compute_type: str = "int8",
    ):
        self._weights_dir = weights_dir
        self._segment_timeout_s = segment_timeout_s
        self._device = device
        self._compute_type = compute_type
        self.last_run: WhisperRunReport | None = None

    def provenance(self, weights_present: bool, revision: str | None, license_name: str | None,
                   language_mode: str = "auto_detect", language: str | None = None) -> ModelProvenance:
        return ModelProvenance(
            analyzer_name=ANALYZER_NAME,
            analyzer_version=ANALYZER_VERSION,
            mode="local_model",
            implementation="faster_whisper_transcribe",
            model_family=MODEL_FAMILY,
            model_revision=revision,
            revision_status="resolved" if revision else "not_resolved",
            license=license_name,
            weights_present=weights_present,
            config_hash=config_hash({
                "family": MODEL_FAMILY,
                "device": self._device,
                "compute_type": self._compute_type,
                "language_mode": language_mode,
                "language": language,
                "beam_size": 5, "vad_filter": False,
                "segment_timeout_s": self._segment_timeout_s,
            }),
        )

    def observe(self, request: AudioObservationRequest) -> ObservationBatch:
        self.last_run = None
        if request.audio_status != "present":
            return self._unavailable(
                request, "modality_missing",
                "No audio stream ingested; no transcript is produced and silence is NOT implied",
            )
        weights = _resolve_weights(self._weights_dir or default_weights_dir())
        if not weights["present"]:
            return self._unavailable(
                request, "weights_absent", f"{WEIGHTS_LABEL} not installed"
            )
        try:
            from faster_whisper import WhisperModel  # lazy; typed unavailable when absent
        except ImportError:
            return self._unavailable(
                request, "dependency_absent", f"Python dependency missing: {DEPENDENCY_LABEL}"
            )
        weights_dir = self._weights_dir or default_weights_dir()
        language = request.language if request.language_mode == "explicit" else None
        started = time.monotonic()
        records: list[TranscriptRecord] = []
        rejections: list[RejectedObservation] = []
        detected_language = None
        model_loaded = invoked = False
        failure_stage = stage_detail = None
        try:
            model = WhisperModel(str(weights_dir.resolve()), device=self._device, compute_type=self._compute_type)
            model_loaded = True
            invoked = True
            segments_iter, info = model.transcribe(
                request.media_path,
                language=language,
                beam_size=5,
                vad_filter=False,  # VAD decisions are not evidence of silence (docs/06)
            )
            detected_language = getattr(info, "language", None)
            for i, seg in enumerate(segments_iter):
                if time.monotonic() - started > self._segment_timeout_s:
                    rejections.append(
                        RejectedObservation(
                            index=i, reason="model_timeout",
                            detail=f"Transcription exceeded {self._segment_timeout_s:.0f}s; "
                                   "partial transcript kept",
                        )
                    )
                    failure_stage, stage_detail = "model_execution", "Segment deadline exceeded"
                    break
                try:
                    records.append(parse_segment(i, seg, detected_language, duration_ms=request.duration_ms))
                except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
                    rejections.append(RejectedObservation(index=i, reason="schema_violation", detail=str(exc)[:300]))
        except Exception as exc:  # runtime failure -> safe partial, never fabricated text
            detail = sanitize(str(exc), [request.media_path, str(weights_dir)], limit=300)
            failure_stage, stage_detail = "model_execution", detail
            rejections.append(
                RejectedObservation(index=len(records), reason="inference_error", detail=detail or type(exc).__name__)
            )
        self.last_run = WhisperRunReport(
            input_sha256=file_sha256(request.media_path),
            output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([r.model_dump(mode="json") for r in records], sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest() if invoked and failure_stage is None else None,
            latency_s=time.monotonic() - started, device=self._device, compute_type=self._compute_type,
            model_revision=weights["revision"], model_loaded=model_loaded, transcription_invoked=invoked,
            segments_accepted=len(records), failure_stage=failure_stage, stage_detail=stage_detail,
            detected_language=detected_language,
        )
        return self._finish(request, records, rejections, weights, detected_language)

    def _finish(self, request, records, rejections, weights, detected_language) -> ObservationBatch:
        if not records and not rejections:
            # An empty ASR result is a report of "no segments returned",
            # never evidence of silence (docs/06).
            rejections.append(
                RejectedObservation(
                    index=0, reason="empty_output",
                    detail="ASR returned zero segments; this is not evidence of silence",
                )
            )
        return ObservationBatch(
            asset_id=request.asset_id,
            modality="acoustic",
            status="ok" if (records and not rejections) else "partial",
            observations=records,
            rejected=rejections,
            provenance=self.provenance(
                True, weights["revision"], weights["license"], request.language_mode, request.language
            ),
            capabilities=CapabilityFlags(
                audio_present=True,
                transcript_available=bool(records),
                sync_valid=None,
            ),
        )

    def _unavailable(self, request: AudioObservationRequest, reason: str, detail: str) -> ObservationBatch:
        return ObservationBatch(
            asset_id=request.asset_id,
            modality="acoustic",
            status="unavailable",
            unavailable=Unavailable(reason=reason, detail=detail, dependency=DEPENDENCY_LABEL),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            provenance=self.provenance(False, None, None, request.language_mode, request.language),
            capabilities=CapabilityFlags(
                audio_present=request.audio_status == "present",
                transcript_available=False,
            ),
        )


def parse_segment(index: int, seg, language: str | None, *, duration_ms: int | None = None) -> TranscriptRecord:
    """Convert a faster-whisper segment to an attributed record.

    ASR internals (avg_logprob / no_speech_prob) are recorded as data; they
    are NOT turned into a correctness confidence (Confidence not_applicable).
    """
    start, end = float(seg.start), float(seg.end)
    if not math.isfinite(start) or not math.isfinite(end) or start < 0:
        raise ValueError("ASR segment timestamps must be finite and nonnegative")
    start_ms = int(round(start * 1000))
    end_ms = int(round(end * 1000))
    if end_ms <= start_ms:
        end_ms = start_ms + 1
    if duration_ms is not None:
        end_ms = min(duration_ms, end_ms)
        if start_ms >= end_ms:
            raise ValueError("ASR segment lies outside decoded audio duration")
    text = (seg.text or "").strip()
    if not text:
        raise ValueError("ASR returned an empty segment; it is not evidence of silence")
    return TranscriptRecord(
        span=Span(start_ms=start_ms, end_ms=end_ms),
        quote=text,
        language=language,
        avg_logprob=getattr(seg, "avg_logprob", None),
        no_speech_prob=getattr(seg, "no_speech_prob", None),
        review_status="unreviewed",
        statement=f"Attributed transcript report (unreviewed), segment {index}",
        confidence=Confidence(kind="not_applicable"),
    )
