        raise ApiError(
            "unprocessable_entity", "Teacher context failed contract validation"
        ) from exc
    context_hash = canonical_json_sha256(context.model_dump(mode="json"))
    existing = session.execute(
        select(TeacherContextVersion).where(
            TeacherContextVersion.project_id == project.id,
            TeacherContextVersion.context_hash == context_hash,
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if existing is not None:
        return existing
    row = TeacherContextVersion(
        id=new_id("teacher_context_version"),
        project_id=project.id,
        context_hash=context_hash,
        payload=context.model_dump(mode="json"),
        created_by=actor,
    )
    session.add(row)
    session.flush()
    return row


def _template_answer_payload(
    project: Project,
    context: TeacherContext,
    snapshot_id: str,
    selected_version_id: str,
    assets: list[AssetContract],
    evidence: list[EvidenceItem],
    observations: list[Observation],
    rejections: list[ProjectionRejection] | None = None,
) -> tuple[dict, list[str]]:
    """Deterministic template rendering; returns (payload, cautions)."""
    cautions = [
        "Template mode: no model inference ran; this answer only restates"
        " recorded observations from one evidence snapshot."
    ]
    for rejection in rejections or []:
        cautions.append(
            f"Record excluded from this answer ({rejection.stage}:"
            f" {rejection.record_kind} {rejection.record_id}): {rejection.reason}"
        )
    claims = [
        claim
        for claim in (
            _claim_for(o, selected_version_id) for o in observations
        )
        if claim is not None
    ]
    next_steps: list[NextStep] = []
    if evidence:
        next_steps = [
            NextStep(
                kind="ask",
                disclosure=_TEMPLATE_DISCLOSURE,
                text=_EVIDENCE_NEXT_STEP_TEXT,
                estimated_seconds=30,
                teacher_approval_required=True,
            )
        ]
    missing_evidence = (
        [] if evidence else ["No active observations exist in this snapshot yet."]
    )
    payload = {
        "schema_version": "0.1",
        "id": new_id("answer"),
        "project_id": project.id,
        "selected_version_id": selected_version_id,
        "snapshot_id": snapshot_id,
        "claims": [c.model_dump(mode="json") for c in claims],
        "next_steps": [n.model_dump(mode="json") for n in next_steps],
        "missing_evidence": missing_evidence,
        "cautions": cautions,
        "context": context.model_dump(mode="json"),
        "mode": "template",
        "status": "validated" if evidence else "draft",
    }
    return payload, cautions


def _reasoning_stack() -> SimpleNamespace:
    """Import the reasoning stack lazily (F03 production AnswerService).

    A missing reasoning dependency is a typed unavailable at ask time — never
    a crash and never a fabricated template answer served as if production.
    """
    try:
        from packages.reasoning.graph.nodes import EvidenceGraph, GraphNode
        from packages.reasoning.guidance.renderer import GuidanceRenderer
        from packages.reasoning.guidance.validate import (
            ValidationFailure,
            validate_answer,
        )
        from packages.reasoning.retrieval.engine import RetrievalEngine
        from packages.reasoning.retrieval.hypotheses import rank_hypotheses
        from packages.reasoning.retrieval.query import parse_query
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ApiError(
            "unavailable",
            "Reasoning stack is unavailable; no answer was fabricated",
        ) from exc
    return SimpleNamespace(
        EvidenceGraph=EvidenceGraph,
        GraphNode=GraphNode,
        GuidanceRenderer=GuidanceRenderer,
        ValidationFailure=ValidationFailure,
        validate_answer=validate_answer,
        RetrievalEngine=RetrievalEngine,
        rank_hypotheses=rank_hypotheses,
        parse_query=parse_query,
    )


_SIDE_VIEW_MARKERS = ("side view", "close-up", "closeup")


def _side_view_in_snapshot(evidence: list[EvidenceItem]) -> bool:
    """An adequate side/close view is one the snapshot explicitly records.

    Absence of such a record is not presence, so the fail-safe default is
    False (docs/11: request the discriminating view only when the snapshot
    does not already satisfy it).
    """
    for item in evidence:
        text = item.statement.lower()
        if item.modality == "visual" and any(marker in text for marker in _SIDE_VIEW_MARKERS):
            return True
    return False


def _design_ancestry(session: Session, project_id: str, selected_version_id: str) -> list[str]:
    """Ancestor version labels of the selected version, oldest first (docs/09
    lineage: prior versions are eligible only as explicitly historical)."""
    row = session.execute(
        select(DesignVersion).where(
            DesignVersion.project_id == project_id,
            DesignVersion.version_id == selected_version_id,
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    chain: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    while row is not None and row.parent_version_row_id and row.parent_version_row_id not in seen:
        seen.add(row.parent_version_row_id)
        row = session.get(DesignVersion, row.parent_version_row_id)
        if row is not None and row.project_id == project_id:
            chain.append(row.version_id)
        else:
            break
    chain.reverse()
    return chain


def _known_component_ids(version_row: DesignVersion) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """Component IDs from the stored design contract; the parser drops any
    token outside this whitelist (docs/09: unknown IDs are never guessed)."""
    ids: list[str] = []
    for component in (version_row.payload or {}).get("components", []) or []:
        if isinstance(component, dict):
            component_id = component.get("id")
            if isinstance(component_id, str) and component_id:
                ids.append(component_id)
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(ids))


def _require_guidance_sources(session: Session, project_id: str, actor: str, asset_ids, *,
                              expected_sha256: dict[str, str] | None = None, settings=None) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Authorize before projection/model use and again before frozen return."""
    from ..authz import scoped_project
    from ..security import CAPABILITY_ANALYZE
    from .consent import require_asset_use
    from .local_inference import server_principal

    scoped_project(session, server_principal(actor, session=session, settings=settings),
                   project_id, CAPABILITY_ANALYZE)
    hashes = {}
    for identifier in sorted(set(asset_ids)):
        source = session.get(Asset, identifier, populate_existing=True)
        if source is None or source.project_id != project_id:
            raise ApiError("not_found", "No such source in your project scope")
        if (source.status != "active" or (expected_sha256 is not None
                and source.sha256 != expected_sha256.get(identifier))):
            raise ApiError("unavailable", "Guidance source is no longer active or immutable", retryable=False)
        require_asset_use(session, source, "analysis")
        require_asset_use(session, source, "teaching_review")
        hashes[identifier] = source.sha256
    return hashes


def _reasoning_answer_payload(
    session: Session,
    project: Project,
    request: AnswerRequest,
    context: TeacherContext,
    selected_version_id: str,
    version_row: DesignVersion,
    assets: list[AssetContract],
    projected_evidence: list[EvidenceItem],
    rejections: list[ProjectionRejection],
    *,
    render_mode: str = "template",
    settings=None,
) -> tuple[dict, str, dict]:
    """Production generation: scoped retrieval -> hypotheses -> policy/renderer
    -> citation validation (F03). Answers read only the frozen snapshot."""
    stack = _reasoning_stack()

    ancestry = _design_ancestry(session, project.id, selected_version_id)
    parsed = stack.parse_query(
        request.question,
        project_id=project.id,
        selected_version_id=selected_version_id,
        known_component_ids=_known_component_ids(version_row),
        parent_version_ids=tuple(ancestry),
    )

    graph = stack.EvidenceGraph(project.id)
    for item in projected_evidence:
        graph.add_node(
            stack.GraphNode(id=item.id, project_id=project.id, type="observation", evidence=item)
        )
    ranked, budget = stack.RetrievalEngine(graph, ancestry=tuple(ancestry)).run(parsed)
    retrieved = [node.evidence for node in ranked if node.evidence is not None]

    # v0.1 persists the snapshot as a context inventory; support/contradict
    # hypothesis edges have no writer yet, and the rule layer never invents
    # them (docs/09). Ranking is therefore the bounded library in deterministic
    # order with full uncertainty until edge persistence lands.
    ranking = stack.rank_hypotheses(retrieved)
    side_view_available = _side_view_in_snapshot(projected_evidence)

    render_inputs = dict(
        answer_id=new_id("answer"),
        project_id=project.id,
        selected_version_id=selected_version_id,
        snapshot_id=request.snapshot_id,
        question=request.question,
        evidence=retrieved,
        ranking=ranking,
        context=context,
        budget=budget,
        side_view_available=side_view_available,
    )
    local_receipt = None
    from . import local_inference as local_runtime
    accounting = local_runtime.CallAccounting()
    if render_mode == "local_model":
        from packages.perception.model_readiness import model_readiness, weights_directory
        readiness = model_readiness("qwen")
        if not readiness.available:
            raise ApiError("unavailable", "Local guidance is unavailable: " + readiness.detail, retryable=False)
        # Source withdrawal/permissions are checked at both model boundaries.
        # The child receives projected values, not live tables or extra media.
        source_hashes = {asset.id: asset.sha256 for asset in assets}
        _require_guidance_sources(session, project.id, request.created_by, source_hashes,
                                  expected_sha256=source_hashes, settings=settings)
        renderer = stack.GuidanceRenderer()
        pre_render_failure = None
        execution = local_runtime.execute_model_task("guidance",
            local_runtime.guidance_task_payload(render_inputs, assets={a.id: a for a in assets},
                ancestry=tuple(ancestry), weights_dir=weights_directory("qwen")),
            data_root=local_runtime.runtime_settings(session, settings).data_root)
        _require_guidance_sources(session, project.id, request.created_by, source_hashes,
                                  expected_sha256=source_hashes, settings=settings)
        accounting = local_runtime.CallAccounting(
            generation_attempts=execution.call_accounting["generation_attempts"],
            actual_vlm_calls=execution.call_accounting["actual_vlm_calls"])
        if execution.error_code in ("prerequisites_unavailable", "model_residency_busy", "model_lease_unavailable"):
            raise ApiError("unavailable", "Local guidance is unavailable: " + execution.error_code,
                           retryable=execution.error_code != "prerequisites_unavailable")
        model_run = execution.result.get("run") if execution.available_result else None
        answer = None
        if execution.available_result:
            try:
                answer = AnswerContract.model_validate(execution.result["answer"])
            except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
                pre_render_failure = {"failure_stage": "output_validation", "error_type": type(exc).__name__}
        else:
            pre_render_failure = {"failure_stage": execution.failure_stage,
                "error_type": execution.error_type, "process_failure": execution.error_code}
        if answer is None:
            answer = renderer.render(**render_inputs)
            answer = answer.model_copy(update={"cautions": list(answer.cautions) + [
                "Local rendering could not prepare, execute or validate this request; the deterministic template fallback is shown."
            ]})
        local_receipt = {
            "readiness": readiness.as_dict(),
            "run": model_run,
            "execution": execution.receipt,
            "call_accounting": accounting.as_dict(),
            "fallback_used": answer.mode == "template",
            "returned_answer_mode": answer.mode,
            **({"pre_render_failure": pre_render_failure} if pre_render_failure else {}),
        }
    else:
        answer = stack.GuidanceRenderer().render(**render_inputs)

    failure = stack.validate_answer(
        answer,
        assets={a.id: a for a in assets},
        evidence_by_id={e.id: e for e in projected_evidence},
        selected_version_id=selected_version_id,
        project_id=project.id,
        snapshot_id=request.snapshot_id,
        side_view_available=side_view_available,
        ancestry=tuple(ancestry),
    )

    cautions = list(answer.cautions)
    if failure is not None:
        if local_receipt is not None:
            # A defensive final validator is independent of the provider's
            # repair. It never requests a third model call.
            local_receipt["service_validation_fallback"] = failure.code
            local_receipt["fallback_used"] = True
            answer = stack.GuidanceRenderer().render(**render_inputs)
            cautions = list(answer.cautions) + [
                "Local-model output failed final citation validation; the deterministic template is shown."
            ]
            failure = stack.validate_answer(
                answer, assets={a.id: a for a in assets},
                evidence_by_id={e.id: e for e in projected_evidence},
                selected_version_id=selected_version_id, project_id=project.id,
                snapshot_id=request.snapshot_id, side_view_available=side_view_available,
                ancestry=tuple(ancestry),
            )
            local_receipt["returned_answer_mode"] = answer.mode
    if failure is not None:
        # Fail closed: the deterministic validator rejected the draft, so no
        # claims are served (docs/09 citation validator; same contract as the
        # bundle-validation downgrade below).
        answer = answer.model_copy(update={"claims": [], "next_steps": [], "status": "draft"})
        cautions.append(
            "Answer withheld: citation validation failed"
            f" ({failure.code}); no claims are served."
        )
        status = "draft"
    else:
        status = "validated" if retrieved else "draft"
    for rejection in rejections:
        cautions.append(
            f"Record excluded from this answer ({rejection.stage}:"
            f" {rejection.record_kind} {rejection.record_id}): {rejection.reason}"
        )
    if local_receipt is None:
        cautions.append("Deterministic rule guidance over snapshot-scoped retrieval; no model inference ran.")
    elif answer.mode == "local_model":
        cautions.append("Local-model wording over snapshot-scoped retrieval; cited claims still require teacher review.")
    elif accounting.actual_vlm_calls:
        cautions.append("Local generation failed execution or validation; the deterministic template fallback is shown.")
    else:
        cautions.append("No model inference ran; local generation failed before execution and the template fallback is shown.")

    payload = answer.model_dump(mode="json")
    payload["cautions"] = cautions
    payload["status"] = status
    if not retrieved:
        payload["missing_evidence"] = list(payload["missing_evidence"]) + [
            "No active observations exist in this snapshot yet."
        ]

    payload, final_status = _validate_bundle_or_draft(assets, retrieved, payload, cautions)
    if local_receipt is not None and payload["mode"] == "local_model" and final_status == "draft" and status != "draft":
        payload["mode"] = "template"
        payload["cautions"].append("Local output failed final bundle validation; no generated claims are served.")
        local_receipt.update(fallback_used=True, returned_answer_mode="template", service_validation_fallback="joint_bundle_validation")

    provenance = {
        "renderer": "guidance-local-model-0.1" if payload["mode"] == "local_model" else "guidance-template-0.1",
        "pipeline": "reasoning",
        "external_inference": "off",
        "context_hash": request.context_hash,
        "snapshot_hash": request.snapshot_hash,
        "rejected_records": [
            {
                "record_id": r.record_id,
                "record_kind": r.record_kind,
                "stage": r.stage,
                "reason": r.reason,
            }
            for r in rejections
        ],
        "retrieval": {
            "selected_observation_ids": [item.id for item in retrieved],
            "engine": "packages.reasoning.retrieval.engine.RetrievalEngine",
            "parsed_query": {
                "question_kind": parsed.question_kind.value,
                "component_ids": list(parsed.component_ids),
                "wants_history": parsed.wants_history,
                "interval": (
                    {"start_ms": parsed.interval.start_ms, "end_ms": parsed.interval.end_ms}
                    if parsed.interval is not None
                    else None
                ),
                "parser": parsed.parser,
            },
            # SR-07 final-selection accounting: the single input-budget source.
            "budget": budget.as_dict(),
            "ancestry": ancestry,
            "retrieved_of_projected": f"{len(retrieved)}/{len(projected_evidence)}",
        },
        "hypotheses": ranking.as_dict(),
        "validator": "accepted" if failure is None else f"withheld:{failure.code}",
        "actual_vlm_calls": accounting.actual_vlm_calls,
        "generation_attempts": accounting.generation_attempts,
        **({"local_model": local_receipt} if local_receipt is not None else {}),
    }
    return payload, final_status, provenance


def _validate_bundle_or_draft(
    assets: list[AssetContract],
    evidence: list[EvidenceItem],
    payload: dict,
    cautions: list[str],
) -> tuple[dict, str]:
    """Validate the full interchange bundle; downgrade to draft if invalid.

    Invalid evidence is never silently served as support: a failed joint
    validation keeps the answer as a draft with the failure recorded in
    cautions.
    """
    status = payload["status"]
    try:
        answer = AnswerContract.model_validate(payload)
        if evidence:
            EvidenceBundle(
                schema_version="0.1",
                project_id=payload["project_id"],
                snapshot_id=payload["snapshot_id"],
                assets=assets,
                evidence=evidence,
                answer=answer,
            )
        return answer.model_dump(mode="json"), status
    except Exception as exc:
        draft = dict(payload)
        draft["status"] = "draft"
        draft["claims"] = []
        draft["next_steps"] = []
        draft["cautions"] = list(cautions) + [
            "Answer withheld: the snapshot failed joint contract validation;"
            " no claims are served."
        ]
        draft["missing_evidence"] = (draft.get("missing_evidence") or []) + [
            f"Contract validation failure: {type(exc).__name__}"
        ]
        return AnswerContract.model_validate(draft).model_dump(mode="json"), "draft"


def ask_question(
    session: Session,
    project: Project,
    *,
    question: str,
    context_payload: dict,
    actor: str,
    selected_version_id: str,
    capabilities: RuntimeCapabilities | None = None,
    render_mode: str | None = None,
    settings=None,
) -> tuple[AnswerRequest, GuidanceAnswer]:
    if not question.strip():
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "A question is required")
    if render_mode not in (None, "template", "local_model"):
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "Guidance render_mode must be template or local_model")

    # Authorize IDs before materializing full observation/source content.
    _require_guidance_sources(session, project.id, actor, (), settings=settings)
    source_ids = session.scalars(select(Observation.asset_id).where(
        Observation.project_id == project.id, Observation.status == "active",
    )).all()
    source_hashes = _require_guidance_sources(session, project.id, actor, source_ids, settings=settings)

    context_version = ensure_context_version(
        session, project, context_payload, actor=actor
    )
    context = TeacherContext.model_validate(context_version.payload)

    snapshot_id = snapshots.new_snapshot_id()
    snapshot_hash = snapshots.current_snapshot_hash(session, project.id)
    snapshots.materialize_edges(session, project, snapshot_id)

    request = AnswerRequest(
        id=new_id("answer_request"),
        project_id=project.id,
        question=question.strip(),
        snapshot_id=snapshot_id,
        snapshot_hash=snapshot_hash,
        context_version_id=context_version.id,
        context_hash=context_version.context_hash,
        status="pending",
        created_by=actor,
    )
    session.add(request)
    session.flush()

    answer = _render_answer(session, project, request, context, selected_version_id, actor,
                            capabilities, render_mode, settings=settings, expected_source_sha256=source_hashes)
    return request, answer


def _snapshot_observations(
    session: Session, project_id: str, snapshot_id: str
) -> list[Observation]:
    """Active observation rows in the FROZEN snapshot inventory, oldest first.

    Generation reads only the snapshot (docs/03): the edge rows materialized at
    ask time define what existed, never the live table.
    """
    edges = snapshots.edges_for_snapshot(session, project_id, snapshot_id)
    rows: list[Observation] = []
    for edge in sorted(edges, key=lambda e: (e.created_at, e.id)):
        row = session.get(Observation, edge.observation_id)
        if row is not None and row.status == "active":
            rows.append(row)
    return rows


def _render_answer(
    session: Session,
    project: Project,
    request: AnswerRequest,
    context: TeacherContext,
    selected_version_id: str,
    actor: str,
    capabilities: RuntimeCapabilities | None = None,
    render_mode: str | None = None,
    *,
    settings=None,
    expected_source_sha256: dict[str, str] | None = None,
) -> GuidanceAnswer:
    _require_guidance_sources(session, project.id, actor, (), settings=settings)
    snapshot_source_ids = {edge.asset_id for edge in snapshots.edges_for_snapshot(session, project.id, request.snapshot_id)}
    _require_guidance_sources(session, project.id, actor, snapshot_source_ids,
                              expected_sha256=expected_source_sha256, settings=settings)
    observations = _snapshot_observations(session, project.id, request.snapshot_id)
    source_ids = {row.asset_id for row in observations}
    source_hashes = _require_guidance_sources(session, project.id, actor, source_ids,
        expected_sha256=expected_source_sha256, settings=settings)
    contract_evidence: list[EvidenceItem] = []
    kept_observations: list[Observation] = []
    rejections: list[ProjectionRejection] = []
    for row in observations:
        item, rejected = _contract_evidence(row)
        if rejected is not None:
            rejections.append(rejected)
        if item is not None:
            contract_evidence.append(item)
            kept_observations.append(row)

    asset_ids = {row.asset_id for row in kept_observations}
    contract_assets: list[AssetContract] = []
    for asset_id in asset_ids:
        asset = session.get(Asset, asset_id)
        if asset is None:
            continue
        converted, rejected = _contract_asset(asset)
        if rejected is not None:
            rejections.append(rejected)
        if converted is not None:
            contract_assets.append(converted)

    version = session.execute(
        select(DesignVersion).where(
            DesignVersion.project_id == project.id,
            DesignVersion.version_id == selected_version_id,
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if version is None:
        raise ApiError(
            "unprocessable_entity",
            "Selected design version does not exist in this project",
        )

    # Runtime config selects the generation path; an unavailable requested
    # mode is a typed failure, never a fabricated answer (docs/03).
    caps = capabilities or get_capabilities()
    configured_mode = (caps.model_mode or "template").strip().lower()
    model_mode = configured_mode
    if render_mode == "local_model":
        model_mode = "local_model"
    elif render_mode == "template" and not caps.fixture_mode:
        model_mode = "reasoning"
    elif render_mode == "template":
        model_mode = "template"
    if model_mode == "local_model" and caps.fixture_mode:
        raise ApiError("unavailable", "Fixture mode cannot claim local-model generation; select an analysis deployment", retryable=False)
    if model_mode in _PRODUCTION_REASONING_MODES or model_mode == "local_model":
        payload, final_status, provenance = _reasoning_answer_payload(
            session,
            project,
            request,
            context,
            selected_version_id,
            version,
            contract_assets,
            contract_evidence,
            rejections,
            render_mode="local_model" if model_mode == "local_model" else "template",
            settings=settings,
        )
    elif model_mode in _FIXTURE_TEMPLATE_MODES:
        payload, cautions = _template_answer_payload(
            project,
            context,
            request.snapshot_id,
            selected_version_id,
            contract_assets,
            contract_evidence,
            kept_observations,
            rejections,
        )
        payload, final_status = _validate_bundle_or_draft(
            contract_assets, contract_evidence, payload, cautions
        )
        provenance = {
            "renderer": "template-0.1",
            "external_inference": "off",
            "context_hash": request.context_hash,
            "snapshot_hash": request.snapshot_hash,
            "actual_vlm_calls": 0,
            "generation_attempts": 0,
            "rejected_records": [
                {
                    "record_id": r.record_id,
                    "record_kind": r.record_kind,
                    "stage": r.stage,
                    "reason": r.reason,
                }
                for r in rejections
            ],
        }
    else:
        raise ApiError(
            "unavailable",
            "Requested guidance mode is not available in this deployment;"
            " no answer was fabricated",
        )

    provenance["requested_render_mode"] = render_mode
    provenance["configured_model_mode"] = configured_mode
    provenance["effective_render_mode"] = payload["mode"]
    _require_guidance_sources(session, project.id, actor, source_ids,
                              expected_sha256=source_hashes, settings=settings)
    from .answer_inputs import freeze
    provenance["input_packet_sha256"] = freeze(
        session, request, version=version, context=context, provenance=provenance,
        projected_ids=[item.id for item in contract_evidence],
    )
    _require_guidance_sources(session, project.id, actor, source_ids,
                              expected_sha256=source_hashes, settings=settings)
    answer = GuidanceAnswer(
        id=payload["id"],
        project_id=project.id,
        request_id=request.id,
        snapshot_id=request.snapshot_id,
        snapshot_hash=request.snapshot_hash,
        selected_design_version_id=selected_version_id,
        mode=payload["mode"],
        status=final_status,
        payload=payload,
        provenance=provenance,
        created_by=actor,
    )
    request.status = "answered"
    session.add(request)
    session.add(answer)
    session.flush()
    return answer


def get_answer(session: Session, project_id: str, answer_id: str) -> GuidanceAnswer:
    return session.execute(
        select(GuidanceAnswer).where(
            GuidanceAnswer.id == answer_id, GuidanceAnswer.project_id == project_id
        )
    ).scalar_one()


def mark_stale_for_project(session: Session, project_id: str) -> list[str]:
    return snapshots.refresh_answer_staleness(session, project_id)


def record_decision(
    session: Session,
    project: Project,
    answer: GuidanceAnswer,
    *,
    action: str,
    rationale: str | None,
    edited_next_step: dict | None,
    actor: str,
    correlation_id: str | None = None,
) -> TeacherDecision:
    if answer.project_id != project.id:
        raise ApiError("not_found", "No such answer in your scope")
    if answer.status == "retracted":
        raise ApiError("conflict", "Answer is retracted and accepts no decisions")
    return _write_decision(
        session,
        project,
        action=action,
        rationale=rationale,
        edited_next_step=edited_next_step,
        actor=actor,
        answer_id=answer.id,
        audit_object=("guidance_answer", answer.id),
        correlation_id=correlation_id,
    )


def create_project_decision(
    session: Session,
    project: Project,
    *,
    action: str,
    rationale: str | None,
    edited_next_step: dict | None,
    actor: str,
    correlation_id: str | None = None,
) -> TeacherDecision:
    """Answer-independent decision (ADR 007 errata #2): the 검출 구간 없음 /
    측정 일부 불가 paths record a judgment with no guidance answer in scope.
    The decision is a first-class teacher record (D23), not an answer
    byproduct."""
    return _write_decision(
        session,
        project,
        action=action,
        rationale=rationale,
        edited_next_step=edited_next_step,
        actor=actor,
        answer_id=None,
        audit_object=("project", project.id),
        correlation_id=correlation_id,
    )


def _write_decision(
    session: Session,
    project: Project,
    *,
    action: str,
    rationale: str | None,
    edited_next_step: dict | None,
    actor: str,
    answer_id: str | None,
    audit_object: tuple[str, str],
    correlation_id: str | None = None,
) -> TeacherDecision:
    if action not in ALLOWED_DECISION_ACTIONS:
        raise ApiError(
            "unprocessable_entity",
            "Decision action must be observe, ask, investigate, explain, maintain,"
            " or rejected_all",
        )
    edited = None
    if edited_next_step is not None:
        try:
            edited = NextStep.model_validate(edited_next_step).model_dump(mode="json")
        except Exception as exc:
            raise ApiError(
                "unprocessable_entity", "Edited next step failed contract validation"
            ) from exc
    decision = TeacherDecision(
        id=new_id("teacher_decision"),
        project_id=project.id,
        answer_id=answer_id,
        action=action,
        rationale=rationale,
        edited_next_step=edited,
        created_by=actor,
    )
    session.add(decision)
    audit_record(
        session,
        actor=actor,
        action="teacher_decision.recorded",
        object_type=audit_object[0],
        object_id=audit_object[1],
        project_id=project.id,
        detail={"action": action},
        correlation_id=correlation_id,
    )
    session.flush()
    return decision


def list_decisions(session: Session, project: Project) -> list[TeacherDecision]:
    """The decision record is re-openable on its own (ADR 007 §7): retrieval is
    direct and never inferred from the existence of follow-up plans."""
    return list(
        session.execute(
            select(TeacherDecision)
            .where(TeacherDecision.project_id == project.id)
            .order_by(TeacherDecision.created_at.asc(), TeacherDecision.id.asc())
        ).scalars()
    )


def correct_observation(
    session: Session,
    project: Project,
    observation: Observation,
    *,
    statement: str | None,
    reported_explanation: str | None,
    measurement: dict | None,
    rationale: str | None,
    actor: str,
    correlation_id: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[Observation, list[str]]:
    """Create a superseding observation; never rewrite the original (D09).

    Returns ``(corrected, answers_marked_stale)``: the snapshot digest changed
    because the old record is now superseded, so dependent answers are marked
    stale without rewriting them (docs/04).
    """
    if observation.project_id != project.id:
        raise ApiError("not_found", "No such observation in your scope")
    if observation.status != "active":
        raise ApiError("conflict", "Only active observations can be corrected")
    if statement is None and reported_explanation is None and measurement is None:
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "A correction must change something")
    if statement is not None and not statement.strip():
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "A corrected statement cannot be empty")

    corrected = Observation(
        id=new_id("observation"),
        project_id=observation.project_id,
        checkpoint_id=observation.checkpoint_id,
        asset_id=observation.asset_id,
        design_version_row_id=observation.design_version_row_id,
        design_version_id=observation.design_version_id,
        modality=observation.modality,
        record_kind=observation.record_kind,
        statement=(statement or observation.statement).strip(),
        symptom=observation.symptom,
        measurement=measurement if measurement is not None else observation.measurement,
        reported_explanation=(
            reported_explanation
            if reported_explanation is not None
            else observation.reported_explanation
        ),
        span_start_ms=observation.span_start_ms,
        span_end_ms=observation.span_end_ms,
        component_ids=list(observation.component_ids or []),
        analyzer=observation.analyzer,
        analyzer_version=observation.analyzer_version,
        config_hash=observation.config_hash,
        provenance_key=f"{observation.provenance_key}|correction:{new_id('observation')}",
        confidence=observation.confidence,
        uncertainty=observation.uncertainty,
        status="active",
        correction_of_id=observation.id,
        created_by=actor,
    )
    # Flush the corrected row first: superseded_by_id references it, and the
    # runtime engine enforces the FK (PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON) at statement
    # time — the unit of work may order the UPDATE before the same-table
    # INSERT otherwise.
    session.add(corrected)
    session.flush()
    observation.status = "superseded"
    observation.superseded_by_id = corrected.id
    session.add(observation)
    session.flush()

    # The snapshot digest changes because the old record is now superseded,
    # which marks dependent answers stale without rewriting them (docs/04).
    answers_marked_stale = snapshots.refresh_answer_staleness(session, project.id)
    audit_record(
        session,
        actor=actor,
        action="observation.corrected",
        object_type="observation",
        object_id=observation.id,
        project_id=project.id,
        detail={"superseded_by": corrected.id, "rationale": rationale},
        correlation_id=correlation_id,
    )
    session.flush()
    return corrected, answers_marked_stale


def evidence_rows_for_snapshot(
    session: Session, project_id: str, snapshot_id: str | None
) -> list["EvidenceEdge"]:
    """Edges for a snapshot; without a snapshot, the newest snapshot served."""
    if snapshot_id is None:
        latest = session.execute(
            select(EvidenceEdge.snapshot_id)
            .where(EvidenceEdge.project_id == project_id)
            .order_by(EvidenceEdge.created_at.desc(), EvidenceEdge.id.desc())
            .limit(1)
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        if latest is None:
            return []
        snapshot_id = latest
    return list(
        session.execute(
            select(EvidenceEdge).where(
                EvidenceEdge.project_id == project_id,
                EvidenceEdge.snapshot_id == snapshot_id,
            )
        ).scalars().all()
    )

"""Checkpoint creation, calibration, and association application services."""
from __future__ import annotations

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from packages.domain.hashing import canonical_json_sha256
from packages.domain.ids import new_id

from ..db import utcnow
from ..errors import ApiError
from ..models import (
    Asset,
    Calibration,
    Checkpoint,
    Component,
    ComponentAssociation,
    DesignVersion,
    Project,
)

PHASES = frozenset({"intention", "build", "test", "revise", "reflect"})
BUILD_CONFIDENCE = frozenset({"explicit", "uncertain"})
ASSOCIATION_AUTHORS = frozenset({"human_confirmed", "model_proposed"})
ASSOCIATION_VISIBILITY = frozenset({"teacher", "researcher", "all"})


def create_checkpoint(
    session: Session,
    project: Project,
    *,
    design_version_id: str,
    phase: str,
    group_pseudonym: str,
    build_version_confidence: str = "uncertain",
    actor: str,
) -> Checkpoint:
    if phase not in PHASES:
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "phase must be a checkpoint phase")
    if build_version_confidence not in BUILD_CONFIDENCE:
        raise ApiError(
            "unprocessable_entity",
            "Physical build-version confidence must be explicit or uncertain",
        )
    if not group_pseudonym.strip():
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "A pseudonymous group label is required")
    version = session.execute(
        select(DesignVersion).where(
            DesignVersion.project_id == project.id,
            DesignVersion.version_id == design_version_id,
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if version is None:
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "Design version does not exist in this project")
    checkpoint = Checkpoint(
        id=new_id("checkpoint"),
        project_id=project.id,
        classroom_id=project.classroom_id,
        design_version_row_id=version.id,
        phase=phase,
        group_pseudonym=group_pseudonym.strip(),
        build_version_confidence=build_version_confidence,
        active_design_version_id=version.version_id,
        active=True,
        created_by=actor,
    )
    session.add(checkpoint)
    session.flush()
    return checkpoint


def create_calibration(
    session: Session,
    checkpoint: Checkpoint,
    *,
    asset_id: str,
    homography: list[list[float]],
    correspondences: list[dict],
    inlier_count: int,
    reprojection_rmse_px: float | None,
    units: str,
    valid_from_ms: int | None,
    valid_to_ms: int | None,
    actor: str,
) -> Calibration:
    if not isinstance(homography, list) or len(homography) != 3 or any(
        len(row) != 3 for row in homography
    ):
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "Homography must be a 3x3 matrix")
    flat = [float(v) for row in homography for v in row]
    if len(flat) != 9 or any(v != v or v in (float("inf"), float("-inf")) for v in flat):
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "Homography entries must be finite numbers")
    if abs(flat[8]) < 1e-12:
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "Homography must be invertible (h22 != 0)")
    if units != "mm":
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "Calibration units are millimeters")
    asset = session.execute(
        select(Asset).where(
            Asset.id == asset_id,
            Asset.project_id == checkpoint.project_id,
            Asset.checkpoint_id == checkpoint.id,
            Asset.status == "active",
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if asset is None:
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "Calibration asset is not in this checkpoint")
    if valid_from_ms is not None and valid_from_ms < 0:
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "valid_from_ms cannot be negative")
    if valid_from_ms is not None and valid_to_ms is not None and valid_to_ms <= valid_from_ms:
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "Calibration range must be a nonempty interval")
    row = Calibration(
        id=new_id("calibration"),
        project_id=checkpoint.project_id,
        checkpoint_id=checkpoint.id,
        asset_id=asset.id,
        homography=homography,
        correspondences=correspondences,
        inlier_count=inlier_count,
        reprojection_rmse_px=reprojection_rmse_px,
        units=units,
        valid_from_ms=valid_from_ms,
        valid_to_ms=valid_to_ms,
        created_by=actor,
    )
    session.add(row)
    session.flush()
    return row


def create_association(
    session: Session,
    checkpoint: Checkpoint,
    *,
    component_id: str,
    asset_id: str,
    region: dict | None,
    track_id: str | None,
    author: str,
    quality: dict,
    visibility: str,
    actor: str,
) -> ComponentAssociation:
    if author not in ASSOCIATION_AUTHORS:
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "author must be human_confirmed or model_proposed")
    if visibility not in ASSOCIATION_VISIBILITY:
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "visibility must be teacher, researcher, or all")
    if region is None and track_id is None:
        raise ApiError(
            "unprocessable_entity", "An association needs an asset region or a track ID"
        )
    if region is not None:
        required = {"x", "y", "w", "h"}
        if not required.issubset(region) or any(
            not isinstance(region[k], (int, float)) or region[k] < 0 for k in required
        ):
            raise ApiError(
                "unprocessable_entity", "Region needs nonnegative x, y, w, h numbers"
            )
    version = session.get(DesignVersion, checkpoint.design_version_row_id)
    component = None
    if version is not None:
        component = session.execute(
            select(Component).where(
                Component.design_version_row_id == version.id,
                Component.component_id == component_id,
            )
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if component is None:
        raise ApiError(
            "unprocessable_entity",
            "Component does not exist in the checkpoint's design version",
        )
    asset = session.execute(
        select(Asset).where(
            Asset.id == asset_id,
            Asset.project_id == checkpoint.project_id,
            Asset.checkpoint_id == checkpoint.id,
            Asset.status == "active",
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if asset is None:
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "Associated asset is not in this checkpoint")
    try:
        from contracts.models import Confidence

        Confidence.model_validate(quality)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ApiError(
            "unprocessable_entity", "Association quality failed contract validation"
        ) from exc

    row = ComponentAssociation(
        id=new_id("component_association"),
        project_id=checkpoint.project_id,
        checkpoint_id=checkpoint.id,
        design_version_row_id=version.id,
        component_id=component_id,
        asset_id=asset.id,
        region=region,
        track_id=track_id,
        author=author,
        quality=quality,
        visibility=visibility,
        version=1,
        created_by=actor,
    )
    session.add(row)
    session.flush()
    return row

"""Live, group-bound source-use checks; declarations are not consent proof.

The existing checkpoint group pseudonym identifies the subject group. A
different group, classroom or project cannot authorize these source bytes.
Only the latest server consent record for that group and use is effective.
No consent-grant endpoint or real-subject record is created by this module.
"""
from sqlalchemy import select

from security.consent import ConsentRecord as PolicyConsent, ConsentViolation, authorize_asset_use
from ..db import as_aware, utcnow
from ..errors import ApiError
from ..models import Asset, Checkpoint, ConsentRecord

_USES = {"analysis": ("review", "local_review"),
         "teaching_review": ("review", "local_review"),
         "research_export": ("research_export", "research_export")}
_SYNTHETIC = {"synthetic_contract_fixture", "synthetic_media"}


def require_asset_use(session, asset: Asset, use: str, *, now=None):
    """Require both the asset declaration and a current scoped consent grant."""
    if use not in _USES:
        raise ValueError("Unknown source use")
    if asset.origin in _SYNTHETIC:
        return
    if (asset.origin != "approved_real" or asset.status != "active"
            or asset.privacy_class != "approved_restricted"
            or use not in (asset.consent_use_flags or [])):
        raise ApiError("unavailable", "Current source use is not authorized", retryable=False)
    checkpoint = session.get(Checkpoint, asset.checkpoint_id, populate_existing=True) if asset.checkpoint_id else None
    if (checkpoint is None or checkpoint.project_id != asset.project_id
            or checkpoint.classroom_id != asset.classroom_id or not checkpoint.group_pseudonym):
        raise ApiError("unavailable", "Source consent has no matching checkpoint group", retryable=False)
    scope, action = _USES[use]
    row = session.scalar(select(ConsentRecord).where(
        ConsentRecord.project_id == asset.project_id,
        ConsentRecord.classroom_id == asset.classroom_id,
        ConsentRecord.subject_pseudonym == checkpoint.group_pseudonym,
        ConsentRecord.scope == scope,
    ).order_by(ConsentRecord.created_at.desc(), ConsentRecord.id.desc())
        .limit(1).execution_options(populate_existing=True))
    consent = None if row is None else PolicyConsent(
        consent_id=row.id, project_id=row.project_id, group_id=row.subject_pseudonym,
        allows_local_review=bool(row.granted) if scope == "review" else False,
        allows_research_export=bool(row.granted) if scope == "research_export" else False,
        expires_at=as_aware(row.expires_at) if row.expires_at else None,
        withdrawn=not row.granted,
    )
    try:
        authorize_asset_use(origin=asset.origin, action=action, consent=consent,
                            project_id=asset.project_id, now=now or utcnow())
    except ConsentViolation as exc:
        raise ApiError("unavailable", "Live group consent does not authorize this source use", retryable=False) from exc


def require_answer_source_use(session, answer):
    """Stored guidance and its packet retain the source's current restrictions."""
    from ..models import AnswerRequest, EvidenceEdge, Observation
    request = session.get(AnswerRequest, answer.request_id)
    if request is not None and isinstance(request.input_packet, dict):
        from packages.domain.hashing import canonical_json_sha256
        if canonical_json_sha256(request.input_packet) != answer.provenance.get("input_packet_sha256"):
            raise ApiError("unavailable", "Stored answer source inventory failed integrity verification", retryable=False)
        sources = request.input_packet.get("assets", [])
        identifiers = {source["id"]: source.get("sha256") for source in sources if isinstance(source, dict) and "id" in source}
    else:
        identifiers = {asset_id: None for asset_id in session.scalars(select(Observation.asset_id)
            .join(EvidenceEdge, EvidenceEdge.observation_id == Observation.id)
            .where(EvidenceEdge.project_id == answer.project_id, EvidenceEdge.snapshot_id == answer.snapshot_id))}
    for identifier, digest in identifiers.items():
        asset = session.get(Asset, identifier, populate_existing=True)
        if (asset is None or asset.project_id != answer.project_id or asset.status != "active"
                or (digest is not None and asset.sha256 != digest)):
            raise ApiError("unavailable", "Stored answer source is no longer available", retryable=False)
        require_asset_use(session, asset, "teaching_review")

"""Design import (D04): validate against the frozen contract, then persist.

The normalized payload is stored verbatim after contract validation; unknown
fields fail closed in ``contracts.models``. A schema-valid v0.1 graph is not
certified to complete a revolution, so every mechanism import carries that
explicit warning instead of implying kinematic validity (docs/04).

mv-design-0.2 (docs/23 C0, ADR 005): a payload with ``design_kind ==
"assembly"`` is validated as an assembly design and persisted in the same
``design_versions`` table with ``mechanism_kind="assembly"``. An assembly is a
structural build record — no mechanism geometry, no expected motion, no
revolvability analysis — so its import warning states structure-only
semantics. Component rows land in the existing ``components`` table (role
``"other"``, ``length_mm`` NULL) for evidence joins; the full structure lives
in the verbatim payload. All other payloads validate as v0.1 with unchanged
behavior.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from contracts.models import AssemblyDesignVersion as AssemblyDesignVersionContract
from contracts.models import DesignVersion as DesignVersionContract
from packages.domain.ids import new_id

from ..errors import ApiError
from ..models import Checkpoint, Component, DesignVersion, Project

REVOLVABILITY_WARNING = (
    "Schema-valid import; revolution range, closure, singularities and branch"
    " continuity are not certified until the simulator checks them."
)

# docs/23 C0: structure-only semantics. No revolvability wording and no
# kinematic certification of any kind is implied for assembly designs.
ASSEMBLY_STRUCTURE_WARNING = (
    "Structural assembly record: component placements and build order only."
    " No mechanism geometry, expected motion, or kinematic analysis is"
    " implied by this import."
)

ASSEMBLY_MECHANISM_KIND = "assembly"


def import_design(
    session: Session,
    project: Project,
    payload: dict,
    *,
    actor: str,
) -> DesignVersion:
    # Import discriminator (docs/23 C0): exactly the assembly marker selects
    # the 0.2 contract; a payload without the marker keeps the v0.1 path
    # byte-identical.
    is_assembly = isinstance(payload, dict) and payload.get("design_kind") == "assembly"
    # A carried-but-unknown design_kind marker is this discriminator's own new
    # input surface, so it fails closed with the typed envelope instead of
    # inheriting the pre-existing v0.1 details quirk (flagged to the lead).
    discriminated = is_assembly or (
        isinstance(payload, dict) and "design_kind" in payload
    )
    contract_model = AssemblyDesignVersionContract if is_assembly else DesignVersionContract
    try:
        contract = contract_model.model_validate(payload)
    except Exception as exc:
        if discriminated:
            # Envelope-safe details (docs/03): loc/type only, no input echo —
            # the stringified validator dump can carry payload values into a
            # response body, and the error contract rejects other shapes.
            errors = exc.errors() if hasattr(exc, "errors") else []
            details = [
                {
                    "loc": [str(part) for part in error.get("loc", ())] or ["payload"],
                    "msg": f"{error.get('type', 'validation_error')}: {error.get('msg', '')}",
                }
                for error in errors[:5]
            ]
            raise ApiError(
                "unprocessable_entity",
                "Design payload failed contract validation",
                details=details or None,
            ) from exc
        # v0.1 raise kept byte-identical, including its pre-existing details
        # shape (flagged to the lead; see worktree handoff for E3-prep).
        raise ApiError(
            "unprocessable_entity",
            "Design payload failed contract validation",
            details=[str(exc.error_count()) if hasattr(exc, "error_count") else str(exc)],
        ) from exc

    if contract.project_id != project.id:
        raise ApiError(
            "unprocessable_entity",
            "Design payload project_id does not match the scoped project",
        )

    version_id = contract.version_id
    existing = session.execute(
        select(DesignVersion).where(
            DesignVersion.project_id == project.id,
            DesignVersion.version_id == version_id,
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if existing is not None:
        raise ApiError(
            "conflict",
            f"Design version {version_id!r} already exists in this project",
        )

    parent_row_id = None
    if contract.parent_version_id is not None:
        parent = session.execute(
            select(DesignVersion).where(
                DesignVersion.project_id == project.id,
                DesignVersion.version_id == contract.parent_version_id,
            )
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        if parent is None:
            raise ApiError(
                "unprocessable_entity",
                "Parent design version does not exist in this project",
            )
        parent_row_id = parent.id

    row = DesignVersion(
        id=new_id("design_version"),
        project_id=project.id,
        version_id=version_id,
        parent_version_row_id=parent_row_id,
        parent_version_id=contract.parent_version_id,
        source_format=contract.source_format,
        source_sha256=contract.source_sha256,
        import_status="imported",
        mechanism_kind=(
            ASSEMBLY_MECHANISM_KIND if is_assembly else contract.mechanism_kind
        ),
        schema_version=contract.schema_version,
        payload=contract.model_dump(mode="json"),
        warnings=[ASSEMBLY_STRUCTURE_WARNING if is_assembly else REVOLVABILITY_WARNING],
        created_by=actor,
    )
    session.add(row)
    session.flush()
    for component in contract.components:
        session.add(
            Component(
                id=new_id("component"),
                project_id=project.id,
                design_version_row_id=row.id,
                component_id=component.id,
                label=component.label,
                # Assembly placements are structural instances, not canonical
                # mechanism roles; geometry stays in the verbatim payload
                # (docs/23 C0), so no length is projected either.
                role="other" if is_assembly else component.role,
                length_mm=None if is_assembly else component.length_mm,
            )
        )
    return row


def get_version(session: Session, project: Project, version_id: str) -> DesignVersion:
    row = session.execute(
        select(DesignVersion).where(
            DesignVersion.project_id == project.id,
            DesignVersion.version_id == version_id,
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if row is None:
        raise ApiError("not_found", "No such design version in this project")
    return row


def checkpoint_active_version(session: Session, checkpoint: Checkpoint) -> DesignVersion:
    return session.get(DesignVersion, checkpoint.design_version_row_id)

    config = module.LocalModelConfig.model_validate(payload["config"])
    started = time.monotonic()
    context = module.request_lineage(request, config)
    if not request.permission_confirmed or not config.approved_weights or config.expected_manifest_sha256 is None:
        raise local_inference._PrerequisitesUnavailable("Fold local analysis is not configured/authorized")
    with Path(payload["source_path"]).open("rb") as stream:
        content = stream.read(module.MAX_IMAGE_BYTES + 1)
    if hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() != request.source_sha256:
        raise ValueError("preprocessing:source_integrity_failed")
    image = module._decode_image(content)
    context.update(image_width=image.width, image_height=image.height, model_id=config.model_id)

    class CountedObserver(module.LocalQwenObserver):
        def load(self):
            super().load()
            if self.model is not None and not isinstance(self.model, local_inference._CountedModel):
                self.model = local_inference._CountedModel(self.model, accounting)

        def generate(self, *args, **kwargs):
            accounting.attempted()
            return super().generate(*args, **kwargs)

    try:
        observer = CountedObserver(config.weights, config=config)
        raw = observer.generate(image, module.build_prompt(request))
        context.update(inference_backend="local_qwen", model_sha256=observer.model_sha256,
            model_config_sha256=observer.model_config_sha256,
            runtime_versions={name: version(name) for name in ("torch", "transformers", "Pillow")})
        try:
            report = module.validate_report(raw, request.image_id, request.source_sha256)
        except (ValueError, TypeError, UnicodeError):
            output = dict(status="invalid", error_code="report_invalid",
                detail="Local output failed the bounded observation/source schema.")
        else:
            visible = any(item.kind == "visible_structure" for item in report.observations)
            output = dict(status="ok" if visible else "unknown", report=report,
                detail="Bounded observation; semantic support remains unverified.")
        result = module.LocalObservationResult(**context, **output,
            elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
        return {"observation": result.model_dump(mode="json")}
    except module._Unavailable as exc:
        raise local_inference._PrerequisitesUnavailable(exc.code) from exc
    finally:
        image.close()


def execute(content, request, config, settings):
    """Parent boundary: bounded private bytes, owned execution, strict receipt."""
    directory = Path(settings.data_root) / "runtime"
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    os.chmod(directory, 0o700)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="fold-source-", dir=directory) as temporary:
        path = Path(temporary) / "image"
        path.write_bytes(content)
        os.chmod(path, 0o600)
        execution = local_inference.execute_model_task("fold", {
            "source_path": str(path), "request": request.model_dump(mode="json"),
            "config": config.model_dump(mode="json")}, data_root=settings.data_root, deadline_s=DEADLINE_S)
    if not execution.receipt.get("cleanup_verified") or not execution.receipt.get("lease_released"):
        raise ApiError("unavailable", "Fold model cleanup could not be verified", retryable=False)
    if execution.error_code in {"prerequisites_unavailable", "model_residency_busy", "model_lease_unavailable"}:
        raise ApiError("unavailable", "Native Fold local observation is unavailable",
            retryable=execution.error_code != "prerequisites_unavailable")
    module = runtime("local_vlm")
    if execution.available_result:
        try:
            result = module.LocalObservationResult.model_validate(execution.result["observation"])
        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as exc:
            raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "Fold observer returned an invalid bounded result") from exc
    else:
        result = module.LocalObservationResult(**module.request_lineage(request, config),
            model_id=config.model_id, status="timeout" if execution.error_code == "hard_deadline_exceeded" else "error",
            error_code="observation_timeout" if execution.error_code == "hard_deadline_exceeded" else "inference_failed",
            detail="The owned Fold model execution did not return a valid observation; no claims were retained.",
            elapsed_seconds=execution.receipt["elapsed_s"])
    if result.status in {"ok", "unknown"} and (
            result.inference_backend != "local_qwen" or result.model_sha256 != config.expected_manifest_sha256):
        raise ApiError("unprocessable_entity", "Fold observer model lineage is invalid")
    return result, execution.receipt, execution.call_accounting

"""Server-authoritative project histories (SR-11, review finding F09).

The classroom overview used to hydrate designs/checkpoints/answers from a
browser-local id index, so a fresh browser could know a project yet see an
empty history. These reads serve the same inventories from the persistent
tables; the local index stays optional acceleration only.

"Current" here means exactly what the schema records, nothing more:

- The newest imported design version (same ordering ``ask_question`` already
  uses when a caller does not pick one) is labeled as such. Importing a
  version does not imply the physical artifact changed (docs/05), so it is
  never presented as a physical state.
- The physical-build association lives on ``Checkpoint``
  (``active_design_version_id`` + ``build_version_confidence``, docs/04).
  Its project-level projection is ``confirmed`` only when active checkpoints
  agree on one explicit association; anything else reports uncertainty
  explicitly instead of inferring a version from ordering.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from ..models import (
    Asset,
    Checkpoint,
    DesignVersion,
    GuidanceAnswer,
    Project,
)

# Cards render phases in checkpoint order, not alphabetical accident.
PHASE_ORDER = ("intention", "build", "test", "revise", "reflect")

# A draft (no evidence yet) or stale (superseded evidence) answer still needs
# the teacher; validated/expired ones do not. Same set the UI filters on.
UNRESOLVED_ANSWER_STATUSES = ("draft", "stale")

LATEST_DESIGN_BASIS = "newest_import"


def latest_design_version(session: Session, project_id: str) -> DesignVersion | None:
    """Newest imported design version, or None before any import."""
    return session.execute(
        select(DesignVersion)
        .where(DesignVersion.project_id == project_id)
        .order_by(DesignVersion.created_at.desc(), DesignVersion.id.desc())
        .limit(1)
    ).scalar_one_or_none()


def physical_build_state(session: Session, project_id: str) -> dict | None:
    """Project-level projection of what checkpoints record about the physical
    build. Returns None when the project has no active checkpoint at all:
    nothing is known, and nothing should be implied."""
    rows = session.execute(
        select(Checkpoint.active_design_version_id, Checkpoint.build_version_confidence)
        .where(Checkpoint.project_id == project_id, Checkpoint.active.is_(True))
    ).all()
    if not rows:
        return None
    explicit = sorted({version_id for version_id, confidence in rows if confidence == "explicit"})
    if len(explicit) == 1:
        return {
            "confirmed": True,
            "design_version_id": explicit[0],
            "confidence": "explicit",
            "uncertainty_reason": None,
            "candidate_version_ids": explicit,
        }
    if len(explicit) > 1:
        return {
            "confirmed": False,
            "design_version_id": None,
            "confidence": "conflicting",
            "uncertainty_reason": (
                "Active checkpoints name different explicit physical build versions"
            ),
            "candidate_version_ids": explicit,
        }
    return {
        "confirmed": False,
        "design_version_id": None,
        "confidence": "uncertain",
        "uncertainty_reason": "No checkpoint records an explicit physical build version",
        "candidate_version_ids": [],
    }


def _count(session: Session, model, *conditions) -> int:
    return int(
        session.execute(select(func.count()).select_from(model).where(*conditions)).scalar_one()
    )


def design_page(
    session: Session, project_id: str, *, limit: int, offset: int
) -> tuple[list[DesignVersion], int]:
    """Import history, newest first: the first page item is the server's
    latest version, so no client ever reconstructs "current" from order."""
    total = _count(session, DesignVersion, DesignVersion.project_id == project_id)
    rows = session.execute(
        select(DesignVersion)
        .where(DesignVersion.project_id == project_id)
        .order_by(DesignVersion.created_at.desc(), DesignVersion.id.desc())
        .limit(limit)
        .offset(offset)
    ).scalars().all()
    return list(rows), total


def checkpoint_page(
    session: Session, project_id: str, *, limit: int, offset: int
) -> tuple[list[Checkpoint], int]:
    """Chronological checkpoint history (created_at, then id as tiebreaker)."""
    total = _count(session, Checkpoint, Checkpoint.project_id == project_id)
    rows = session.execute(
        select(Checkpoint)
        .where(Checkpoint.project_id == project_id)
        .order_by(Checkpoint.created_at, Checkpoint.id)
        .limit(limit)
        .offset(offset)
    ).scalars().all()
    return list(rows), total


def answer_page(
    session: Session, project_id: str, *, limit: int, offset: int
) -> tuple[list[GuidanceAnswer], int]:
    """Answer history, newest first, so the current follow-up state leads."""
    total = _count(session, GuidanceAnswer, GuidanceAnswer.project_id == project_id)
    rows = session.execute(
        select(GuidanceAnswer)
        .where(GuidanceAnswer.project_id == project_id)
        .order_by(GuidanceAnswer.created_at.desc(), GuidanceAnswer.id.desc())
        .limit(limit)
        .offset(offset)
    ).scalars().all()
    return list(rows), total


def project_summary(session: Session, project: Project) -> dict:
    """Aggregate card state for one project, computed from rows only.

    Returns raw fields; the router maps rows through the existing DTO
    serializers so response shaping stays in one place.
    """
    project_id = project.id
    phases = [
        row
        for row in session.execute(
            select(Checkpoint.phase)
            .where(Checkpoint.project_id == project_id, Checkpoint.active.is_(True))
            .distinct()
        ).scalars()
    ]
    latest_answer_status = session.execute(
        select(GuidanceAnswer.status)
        .where(GuidanceAnswer.project_id == project_id)
        .order_by(GuidanceAnswer.created_at.desc(), GuidanceAnswer.id.desc())
        .limit(1)
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    return {
        "project": project,
        "latest_design": latest_design_version(session, project_id),
        "latest_design_basis": LATEST_DESIGN_BASIS,
        "physical_build": physical_build_state(session, project_id),
        "design_version_count": _count(session, DesignVersion, DesignVersion.project_id == project_id),
        "checkpoint_count": _count(
            session, Checkpoint, Checkpoint.project_id == project_id, Checkpoint.active.is_(True)
        ),
        "checkpoint_phases": sorted(set(phases), key=PHASE_ORDER.index),
        "asset_count": _count(
            session, Asset, Asset.project_id == project_id, Asset.status == "active"
        ),
        "answer_count": _count(session, GuidanceAnswer, GuidanceAnswer.project_id == project_id),
        "unresolved_answer_count": _count(
            session,
            GuidanceAnswer,
            GuidanceAnswer.project_id == project_id,
            GuidanceAnswer.status.in_(UNRESOLVED_ANSWER_STATUSES),
        ),
        "latest_answer_status": latest_answer_status,
    }

"""Job execution shared by the API (in-process drain) and the RQ worker.

The same function runs a job in both places so worker semantics are not a
second implementation. Transient failures retry with exponential backoff up
to two times; deterministic unavailability (invalid synthetic manifest,
unregistered analyzer, unsupported asset type, undecodable media, missing
anchors/calibration) never retries.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import time
import hashlib

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from packages.domain.jobs import JobState, MAX_TRANSIENT_RETRIES

from ..db import utcnow
from ..config import get_settings
from ..errors import ApiError
from ..models import Asset, Checkpoint, DesignVersion, ProcessingJob
from ..security import require_media_origin
from . import analyzers, snapshots
from .jobs import record_heartbeat, requeue_for_retry_or_recovery, transition

TRANSIENT_FAILURE_CODES = frozenset({"transient_io_error"})
RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS = 1.0


def execute_processing_job(session: Session, job_id: str, *, settings=None) -> ProcessingJob:
    """Run one job to a terminal state in the given session/transaction."""
    job = session.get(ProcessingJob, job_id)
    if job is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown processing job: {job_id}")
    if job.state in (JobState.SUCCEEDED.value, JobState.PARTIAL.value):
        return job
    if job.state == JobState.QUEUED.value:
        transition(session, job, JobState.RUNNING)
    elif job.state != JobState.RUNNING.value:
        return job
    job.attempts += 1
    record_heartbeat(session, job)
    runtime_settings = settings or session.info.get("mv_runtime_settings") or get_settings()
    session.info["mv_runtime_settings"] = runtime_settings

    asset = session.get(Asset, job.asset_id) if job.asset_id else None
    if asset is None:
        return _fail(session, job, "missing_asset", "Job asset is missing", retryable=False)
    try:
        require_media_origin(runtime_settings, asset.origin)
    except ApiError:
        return _fail(session, job, "source_not_authorized", "This worker mode does not permit the source origin", retryable=False)
    from .consent import require_asset_use
    try:
        require_asset_use(session, asset, "analysis")
    except ApiError:
        return _fail(session, job, "source_consent_unavailable", "Live consent does not authorize this source analysis", retryable=False)

    analyzer_fn = _resolve(job.analyzer_name, job.analyzer_version)
    if analyzer_fn is None:
        return _fail(
            session,
            job,
            "analyzer_not_registered",
            f"{job.analyzer_name}@{job.analyzer_version} is not registered in this deployment",
            retryable=False,
        )

    try:
        _require_current_job_source(session, job, asset, runtime_settings)
        outcome = analyzer_fn(session, job, asset)
    except analyzers.AnalyzerUnavailable as exc:
        # Deterministic: do not retry invalid input (docs/03).
        return _fail(session, job, exc.code, exc.message, retryable=False)
    except Exception as exc:  # transient I/O or unknown
        return _fail(
            session,
            job,
            "transient_io_error",
            f"Analyzer raised {type(exc).__name__}",
            retryable=True,
            exc=exc,
        )

    try:
        session.refresh(asset)
        require_asset_use(session, asset, "analysis")
    except ApiError:
        return _fail(session, job, "source_consent_unavailable", "Source consent changed during analysis", retryable=False)
    try:
        _require_current_job_source(session, job, asset, runtime_settings)
    except analyzers.AnalyzerUnavailable as exc:
        return _fail(session, job, exc.code, exc.message, retryable=False)

    if isinstance(outcome, analyzers.IngestOutcome):
        return _finish_ingest(session, job, outcome)

    checkpoint = session.get(Checkpoint, job.checkpoint_id) if job.checkpoint_id else None
    design_version = None
    if checkpoint is not None:
        design_version = session.get(DesignVersion, checkpoint.design_version_row_id)
    if checkpoint is None or design_version is None:
        return _fail(
            session, job, "missing_scope", "Checkpoint or design version missing", retryable=False
        )

    analyzers.persist_outcome(session, job, asset, checkpoint, design_version, outcome)
    # New evidence changes the project's snapshot digest, so dependent
    # answers become stale (docs/03: new evidence marks answers stale).
    snapshots.refresh_answer_staleness(session, job.project_id)

    target = JobState.SUCCEEDED if outcome.complete else JobState.PARTIAL
    record_heartbeat(session, job)
    transition(session, job, target)
    return job


def _require_current_job_source(session, job, asset, settings):
    """Recheck queued actor scope and source identity before accepting work."""
    from ..authz import scoped_project
    from ..objectstore import store_from_settings
    from ..security import CAPABILITY_ANALYZE, Principal

    via = "research_session" if settings.authentication_mode == "research_session" else "session_header"
    try:
        scoped_project(session, Principal(job.created_by, "principal", frozenset(), via),
                       job.project_id, CAPABILITY_ANALYZE)
    except ApiError as exc:
        raise analyzers.AnalyzerUnavailable("source_scope_invalid", "Current project analysis permission is unavailable") from exc
    if (asset.status != "active" or asset.project_id != job.project_id
            or asset.checkpoint_id != job.checkpoint_id):
        raise analyzers.AnalyzerUnavailable("source_scope_invalid", "Queued source identity or scope changed")
    if asset.sha256 != job.asset_sha256:
        raise analyzers.AnalyzerUnavailable("source_hash_mismatch", "Source digest no longer matches queued analysis")
    # The explicitly labeled manifest reference never reads decoded source
    # bytes. Every production byte-reading branch checks the original store.
    if job.analyzer_name == analyzers.FIXTURE_STALL_RULE:
        return
    source_path = store_from_settings(settings).path_for(asset.stored_key)
    try:
        if source_path.stat().st_size != asset.size_bytes:
            raise analyzers.AnalyzerUnavailable("source_hash_mismatch", "Immutable source size changed")
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        read_bytes = 0
        with source_path.open("rb") as source:
            for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                read_bytes += len(block)
                if read_bytes > asset.size_bytes:
                    raise analyzers.AnalyzerUnavailable("source_hash_mismatch", "Immutable source size changed during reading")
                digest.update(block)
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise analyzers.AnalyzerUnavailable("source_content_unavailable", "Immutable source bytes are unavailable") from exc
    if digest.hexdigest() != asset.sha256:
        raise analyzers.AnalyzerUnavailable("source_hash_mismatch", "Immutable source SHA changed")


def _resolve(analyzer_name: str, analyzer_version: str):
    if not analyzers.is_registered(analyzer_name, analyzer_version):
        return None
    # Single dispatch table in the registry: the fixture rule, the ingest
    # pipeline, and the SR-04 real media-motion path each run their own
    # executor; nothing is silently routed to a different analyzer.
    return analyzers.analyzer_executable(analyzer_name, analyzer_version)


def _finish_ingest(
    session: Session, job: ProcessingJob, outcome: "analyzers.IngestOutcome"
) -> ProcessingJob:
    """Terminal handling for derivative-producing analyzers.

    Ingest persists derivatives itself and produces no observations, so
    there is no checkpoint/design-version scope requirement and no
    snapshot/staleness refresh; the report (capabilities, typed failures)
    is the job's result, and any branch failure keeps the job PARTIAL
    rather than reporting success (docs/06 partial processing).
    """
    report = outcome.report
    job.capability_flags = list(report.get("flags", []))
    job.result_refs = {
        "report": report,
        "analyzer_complete": outcome.complete,
        "computed_at": utcnow().isoformat(),
    }
    session.flush()
    target = JobState.SUCCEEDED if outcome.complete else JobState.PARTIAL
    record_heartbeat(session, job)
    transition(session, job, target)
    return job


def _fail(
    session: Session,
    job: ProcessingJob,
    code: str,
    message: str,
    *,
    retryable: bool,
    exc: Exception | None = None,
) -> ProcessingJob:
    can_retry = retryable and job.attempts <= MAX_TRANSIENT_RETRIES
    job.failure_code = code
    job.failure_message = message
    record_heartbeat(session, job)
    if can_retry:
        # Transient failure: bounded exponential backoff, then requeue.
        job.retryable = True
        if exc is not None:
            time.sleep(min(RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS * job.attempts, 2.0))
        requeue_for_retry_or_recovery(session, job)
        return job
    job.retryable = retryable
    transition(session, job, JobState.FAILED)
    return job

"""Processing job records: idempotent creation, transitions, dispatch.

Job identity is the five-part idempotency key. A repeated key returns the

Changed source/setup/configuration creates a new key and a new audit row.

from datetime import timedelta
from fractions import Fraction

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from packages.domain.ids import new_id
from packages.domain.jobs import (
    MAX_TRANSIENT_RETRIES,

    JobState,
    assert_recovery_requeue,
    assert_transition,
    compute_config_hash,
    is_terminal,
)

def build_key(

    asset: Asset,
    analyzer_name: str,
    analyzer_version: str,
    config: dict,
    parent_snapshot_hash: str,
) -> IdempotencyKey:

        asset_sha256=asset.sha256,
        analyzer_name=analyzer_name,
        analyzer_version=analyzer_version,
        config_hash=compute_config_hash(scoped_configuration(asset, config)),
        parent_snapshot_hash=parent_snapshot_hash,
    )


def scoped_configuration(asset: Asset, config: dict) -> dict:
    """Identical bytes in another project are separate authorized analyses."""
    return {**config, "_mv_scope": {
        "project_id": asset.project_id, "asset_id": asset.id,
        "checkpoint_id": asset.checkpoint_id, "design_version_id": asset.design_version_id,
    }}


def analysis_configuration(session: Session, checkpoint: Checkpoint, asset: Asset,
                           analyzer_name: str, config: dict) -> dict:
    """Freeze server-owned geometry dependencies at enqueue time.

    The browser cannot supply or override this inventory. A new confirmed
    pin/calibration produces a new key even when the evidence table is empty.
    An empty inventory stays empty if setup is added while a job is queued.
    """

    # Reserved inventories are always server-owned, including on analyzers
    # which do not consume them. A browser cannot smuggle an alternate source.
    result.pop("_mv_frames", None)
    if analyzer_name == "media-motion-alignment":
        calibration_ids = session.scalars(select(Calibration.id).where(
            Calibration.project_id == checkpoint.project_id,
            Calibration.checkpoint_id == checkpoint.id, Calibration.asset_id == asset.id,

        association_ids = session.scalars(select(ComponentAssociation.id).where(
            ComponentAssociation.project_id == checkpoint.project_id,
            ComponentAssociation.checkpoint_id == checkpoint.id, ComponentAssociation.asset_id == asset.id,
            ComponentAssociation.status == "active", ComponentAssociation.author == "human_confirmed",
        ).order_by(ComponentAssociation.id)).all()
        result["_mv_geometry"] = {
            "calibration_ids": list(calibration_ids), "association_ids": list(association_ids),
            "design_version_row_id": checkpoint.design_version_row_id,
